name: Shelly Arnoldi
subject: Two days to go!
body:
Election Day is Tuesday — Get to the polls. Bring a friend. Help do something nobody thought could happen.
| | | | |
---
| |
---
| Dear Neighbor,
Election Day is in two days -- Tuesday, November 3rd. I'm asking you to get to the polls and bring a friend and a neighbor with you.
Help do something that almost nobody thought could happen in [Virginia's 8th District](https://5f9eawebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-dWkINVvgAJIRC211nMjaeHlliNa4x1Y3pYy5_woCzrTJozomOvx8lQmU0yshSsCg1GagGv8GPhH-c2S6D7R0aphQtj9t3ttI4KVXN4rFoQIrd06VV8dv_gaxzExJErwhe7NT4jFWqJZ12Ksa7H-ebsNkpRsBdzI9Kh4su-eyCfCxPVZEd7H_nfKmA7gFbJKeJoiDMW8GoTyAnI8wahJjA==&c=7opgn2VMg2Ulu5UJXLoWmbXW7oyfsWIcoafRHLvK_BPCKuIStCPIZg==&ch=FZBJVptyPUW6xFPwaAxoF4fotbOI_Xmq3SWDoN8GISQTYPXb4IBtEg==): elect a third-party candidate who takes her oath to support and defend the U.S. Constitution at all costs. I won't be bought. I have refused PAC money, big-donor strings, and the usual political consultants who flood your phone with annoying text messages and stuff your mailbox with junk mail. I've run this campaign for under $5,000 total because I answer to voters, not special interests.
Representatives in Congress are just regular people. Anyone can do this. I'm a Navy veteran, licensed professional engineer, wife, and mom who has raised four kids in Northern Virginia. I watched government drift away from the people it's supposed to serve -- especially after school closures, mandates, and the erosion of parental rights. We need people in Congress who refuse to be owned by special interest groups. Average citizens can accomplish a lot when we work together. I'm inviting regular people to get off the bench, participate, and help save our country.
[Virginia's 8th Congressional District](https://5f9eawebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-dWkINVvgAJIRC211nMjaeHlliNa4x1Y3pYy5_woCzrTJozomOvx8lQmU0yshSsCg1GagGv8GPhH-c2S6D7R0aphQtj9t3ttI4KVXN4rFoQIrd06VV8dv_gaxzExJErwhe7NT4jFWqJZ12Ksa7H-ebsNkpRsBdzI9Kh4su-eyCfCxPVZEd7H_nfKmA7gFbJK4OFu0hASFTax_BBE9I97kw==&c=7opgn2VMg2Ulu5UJXLoWmbXW7oyfsWIcoafRHLvK_BPCKuIStCPIZg==&ch=FZBJVptyPUW6xFPwaAxoF4fotbOI_Xmq3SWDoN8GISQTYPXb4IBtEg==) has about 171 voting precincts across Arlington County, the City of Alexandria, the City of Falls Church, and the eastern portion of Fairfax County. On Tuesday, the regular blue and red tables will likely be set up at nearly every one of them. I'm asking you to vote intentionally. Don't just show up and check the same box you've always checked. Look at who is actually willing to take the oath seriously and refuse to be owned.
We need to break from the D & R system that is clearly controlled by PACs and start electing Americans who will take their oath seriously. If anyone wants to help at their local precinct -- holding a sign, talking to neighbors, or just being a visible presence -- please let me know. Reply to this email or reach out through my campaign site.
Here are three short videos so you can hear it directly from me:
1\. More is on my site: [https://shellyarnoldi4va.org/](https://5f9eawebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001-dWkINVvgAJIRC211nMjaeHlliNa4x1Y3pYy5_woCzrTJozomOvx8qQ0HAnkdLGE8e7WOFjAdmTM_-7vc63o9XQR5fIHZ0R6B3dCoMaz5VO8SgHA9e7UKRCcyc7Rg7ADFLSh7pLfHUcVws2gGBOla7j_YxMXZY49fEzFB_JftsI=&c=7opgn2VMg2Ulu5UJXLoWmbXW7oyfsWIcoafRHLvK_BPCKuIStCPIZg==&ch=FZBJVptyPUW6xFPwaAxoF4fotbOI_Xmq3SWDoN8GISQTYPXb4IBtEg==)
If you live in Arlington, Alexandria, Falls Church, or the eastern Fairfax County portion of the 8th District, please vote Shelly Arnoldi on Tuesday. Bring someone with you. Let's show that regular people who won't be owned can still make a difference.
With gratitude and resolve, Shelly Arnoldi
Libertarian candidate for U.S. House, Virginia's 8th District Navy veteran | Professional Engineer | Mom
P.S. If you've already voted early, thank you -- and still bring a friend or neighbor to the polls. Every intentional vote counts when we're doing what the status quo said couldn't be done.

name: Chris Pappas
subject: One last message from me
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=9925%2E582294%2E4RYMZ6 ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=9925%2E582294%2E4RYMZ6 ]Chris Pappas for Senate

We’ve come a long way together since we started this campaign 18 months
ago. Now this is one of the biggest moments of our fight to keep New
Hampshire blue.

Tonight at midnight is our campaign’s final monthly deadline of the
election.

And the $2 million goal our campaign set is not arbitrary – it’s critical
and non-negotiable.

Why? Because John Sununu’s backers – Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and the
Republican establishment and their network of special interest donors –
are already spending over $67 million to buy this seat.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261031_6.IvocAZ&refcode=em20261031-6&t=1003&akid=9925%2E582294%2E4RYMZ6 ]Can I count on you to chip in $5 or any amount to help us
fight back against this wave of outside spending before it’s too late?

The GOP and the MAGA billionaires backing them are determined to elect
John Sununu and flip this seat red. That’s why they are hoping we fall
short tonight.

With Election Day in just three days, every single hour matters. And every
dollar has to stretch farther.

That’s why I’m reaching out one last time to ask for your support: not
because it’s a nice-to-have. It’s the only way we’ll be able to win this
race.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261031_6.IvocAZ&refcode=em20261031-6&t=1004&akid=9925%2E582294%2E4RYMZ6 ]Please will you chip in anything you can before our October
end-of-month deadline at MIDNIGHT to help us reach our $2 million goal and
keep us on track to win?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261031_6.IvocAZ&amount=5&refcode=em20261031-6&t=1023&akid=9925%2E582294%2E4RYMZ6 ]Donate $5 »

Thank you,

Chris Pappas

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.chrispappas.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=9925%2E582294%2E4RYMZ6

**Good Morning!** On this day in 2023, the Texas Rangers [beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-0](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGurCAQBuCnwQ4DiMtaUNzGbm97SzPCqOSiGJgje97-xH2F000yyZf___-9pheEGI71L-xo6b2k6cBaIhJhnq5E4VgzupR9hfgf5ogu7fvXpIR6cCm5kBM4ChdOGhpvZ-EH2aCVZuj6TvdGN5s1xj-9Vj167YzsZ9-ZYejMszNigL5TTbA3J6WQUgmlh9YYNKDdbGbsF_eUTAv0gVJuaUPCN5QlfqcLc-vS3kS7EZ2FdX-YGpkaa63tMTu_1PvN1Hg3YmosZ8p0H3ucmRqBeEzHyiMU4rQh_8A8w7FiLhwy8ppy9LxgDli422A_QzpuocnWnzXEGMrDMC3WHUL8hKHfjnhZ9RMAAP__uXqJEQ) to win their first World Series in franchise history. The title came 51 years after the team moved to Arlington. Daylight saving time ended at 2 a.m. We hope you enjoyed the extra hour of sleep, but remember the oven and car clocks won't fix themselves. In case you missed it on _Flyover Focus_ , we counted down the 10 most common scams putting Americans in danger right now, deceptions that cost victims $20 billion last year alone. Plus, one scam on the list threatens to drain an entire retirement account. How many of them would you spot before it's too late? Today is the final day of early voting in Ohio. Already, we've broken records for the number of ballots cast before Election Day. As of last night, 1,595,206 Ohioans have already voted. Because of you, we're making history.
We're closing in on our opportunity to turn the page on Jon Husted's failures and send a loud message that Ohioans should come before billionaires and special interests.
Every day, this campaign proves that we have more power together than those greedy billionaires ever will. I'm honored to play a role in sending that message.
This race will be a nail-biter - that's a fact. But I know that we can win. With just one more push.
**We 're getting our closing message out to Ohioans all over this state. [I can't do it without you. I'm asking you to pitch in to fund our final campaign push. Please donate now, if you can.](https://substack.com/redirect/bc4d2675-483b-4970-9f19-98f60998c97e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
I know we can win because Ohioans can see more money going out than coming in, and they're tired of it.
Because they heard Donald Trump and Jon Husted promise to lower their costs over and over, just to turn around and give tax breaks to the ultra-wealthy, _not_ Ohio families.
Because folks in all 88 counties are fed up with this corrupt system, and we're fighting back.
Early voting in Ohio will wrap up in just a few hours.
We're watching early voting data live. We can see which counties are overperforming and if there are any areas that aren't keeping pace. We can see where there are voters who should turn out in support for our campaign and ensure we can get organizers and volunteers in their communities to mobilize them in time.
Every dollar we raise right now goes toward reaching those voters before polls close, and will make sure we have the staff capacity to hold the line on Election Day too.
So now, I have one question for you.
_Are you ready to win this election together?_
We can do this, but we have to give everything we can. I need you with me more than ever. If you have the means,**[I'd like to ask if you can contribute to my campaign to help us run through the tape](https://substack.com/redirect/bc4d2675-483b-4970-9f19-98f60998c97e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[.](https://substack.com/redirect/bc4d2675-483b-4970-9f19-98f60998c97e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) If you can't, it'd mean a lot if you can forward this to someone who can.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/bc4d2675-483b-4970-9f19-98f60998c97e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=5574704&post_id=222962681&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjIyOTYyNjgxLCJpYXQiOjE3OTM1MzcwNzksImV4cCI6MTc5NjEyOTA3OSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTU1NzQ3MDQiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.x3Xi4INh0IGB9SceOHBeNr18ncFSfqWUdvXVv6g53uQ)
Thank you for meeting this moment with energy, enthusiasm, and action. I'm beyond grateful.
Sherrod Brown

Everything will add up and put us one step closer to flipping the Senate in November.](https://substack.com/redirect/bc4d2675-483b-4970-9f19-98f60998c97e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

body:
We need your help to reach every last voter.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1938&source=&t=1&akid=5132%2E124072%2Ei-f19H) | | | |

$5, Peter.
That’s how much we’re asking you to pitch in to help us fund our final get-out-the-vote efforts before Election Day.
| | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1938&amount=5&t=8&akid=5132%2E124072%2Ei-f19H)
---
In the final two days of this race, your support is crucial:
💥 $5 to help us knock on more doors and call more voters.
💥 $5 to reach undecided voters with our message before the GOP gets to them first.
💥 $5 to fight back against the lies that President Trump, Vice President Vance and Michael Whatley have spread about me.
💥 $5 to put up more yard signs, host more campaign events and make sure every single North Carolinian knows what’s at stake in this race.
**💥 $5 to flip this seat, take back the Senate and put a check on Trump’s corrupt and chaotic Administration once and for all.**
Peter, we know it’s hard to believe your $5 can do all of these things. But by the time you get to this point in the message, lots of other grassroots supporters will have chipped in their $5 – and now they’re counting on you to do the same.
[**_With Election Day 48 hours away, we have to ask: Will you make your first donation to Roy Cooper’s campaign so we can reach every last voter, win in NC and take back the Senate?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1938&amount=5&t=9&akid=5132%2E124072%2Ei-f19H)

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1938&source=&t=3&akid=5132%2E124072%2Ei-f19H)

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In California’s 7th Congressional district, Rep. Doris Matsui is launching
an all-out blitz against Justice Democrat Mai Vang.

Recently, Matsui wrote herself a $1.5 million check, bringing her total
self-funded loan to her campaign to nearly $7,000,000.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261101-1-mv.tPkabI&refcode=em20261101-38406&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=38406%2E1203867%2Evr4p0M ]Tweet by Usamah Andrabi: The question is does the $7 million Doris
Matsui loaned herself come from the $38 million she’s made off insider
stock trading or the $33 billion her family made off selling her husband’s
AI data center-supporting energy company to BlackRock.

At the same time, a shady pop-up super PAC called “Affordable California
2026” appeared out of nowhere to pour $750,000 into negative attack ads
against Mai — meaning Matsui’s relying on TWO different AIPAC
pass-throughs to help defend her seat.

These aren’t the moves of an incumbent who thinks she can win. These are
desperate measures of someone terrified of losing her grip on power.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261101-1-mv.tPkabI&refcode=em20261101-38406&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=38406%2E1203867%2Evr4p0M ]Rush any amount right now to Mai Vang and Justice Democrats to make
sure we can fight back and win this Tuesday!

We already proved what grassroots power can do,
Peter. Even when Matsui tried to drown Mai out
by funneling $1.4 million of her own wealth into her race and urging her
megadonors to boost the Republican candidate during the primary, Mai still
came out on top.

In just two days, we’re ready to put an end to the 50-year Matsui dynasty
that has sold out to the exact special interests making working families’
lives unaffordable — from ICE contractors to Big Pharma to corporate PACs.

We need leaders like Mai who reject corporate cash to join our progressive
bloc in Congress, working to hold Trump, the establishment, and their
billionaire donors accountable and finally deliver the change everyday
people need.

Matsui thinks she can buy this election at the last second with dark money
and millions in personal wealth. But Mai can win this election with
you, Peter.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261101-1-mv.tPkabI&refcode=em20261101-38406&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1004&akid=38406%2E1203867%2Evr4p0M ]With just two days left, we need every resource possible to fuel our
GOTV operations, oust a Do-Nothing Democratic incumbent, and get Mai
across the finish. Split $10 or any amount between Mai’s
campaign and Justice Democrats right now →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261101-1-mv.tPkabI&refcode=em20261101-38406&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1023&akid=38406%2E1203867%2Evr4p0M ]Contribute $10

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

subject: What I'm thinking about over coffee this morning
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
Peter, I've got my morning espresso in hand, and some thoughts to share with you.
It’s November 1st, and Election Day is this Tuesday. It feels _crazy_ to type that out, but here we are.
I can't stop thinking about how we got here.
Last year in April, I remember talking to 5 people in a room. At the start of this campaign, we hosted events in small coffee shops, and our entire staff fit in one car.
Now, we have an army of 25,000 volunteers; we’ve brought this campaign to hundreds of cities and packed venues with thousands of supporters, and we’ve broken fundraising records with this incredible grassroots team.
_**You**_**did that, Peter.** You chipped in when it was hard, you showed up, you spread the word, and you've stood by my side day in and day out.
Now, it all comes down to the next couple of days.
Tons of Michiganders still don't know who they're voting for. A lot of them don't even know there's an election on Tuesday.
And let me be clear — that's not a knock on them. People are busy working two jobs, getting the kids to school, trying to afford groceries. It shouldn't be this hard to keep up, and politics is the last thing on their mind.
**But these folks may hold the fate of this election in their hands.** The last time Mike Rogers ran for this seat, it came down to 20,217 votes. If it’s that close again, it’ll truly come down to these last-minute voters.
MAGA Republicans are spending $157 million to try and bring those folks onto their side. We can’t outspend that, so our job is simple. Find every one of these undecided voters and make sure they:
A. Have a plan to vote, and know where and when.
B. Hear from _us,_ so they'll vote in support of a campaign that's fighting for working people.
That means organizers on the doors, volunteers on the phones, and our message on every screen we can reach. All of it costs money. I've never taken a dime from corporate PACs, so I'm not asking them. I'm asking you, Peter.
**Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can afford to help us reach every Michigander who still needs a plan to vote before Tuesday?**
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20261101-1-ak**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261101-1-ak.0ecxdv&amount=5&refcode=em20261101-3825&t=2&akid=3848%2E251025%2EWPiSVf)
Thank you for supporting our campaign in the final stretch.
Your friend in the fight,
Abdul

I can't stop thinking about how we got here. Last year in April, I remember talking to 5 people in a room. At the start of this campaign, we hosted events in small coffee shops, and our entire staff fit in one car. Now, we have an army of 25,000 volunteers; we’ve brought this campaign to hundreds of cities and packed venues with thousands of supporters, and we’ve broken fundraising records with this incredible grassroots team. Youdid that, Peter. You chipped in when it was hard, you showed up, you spread the word, and you've stood by my side day in and day out. Now, it all comes down to the next couple of days. Tons of Michiganders still don't know who they're voting for. A lot of them don't even know there's an election on Tuesday. And let me be clear — that's not a knock on them. People are busy working two jobs, getting the kids to school, trying to afford groceries. It shouldn't be this hard to keep up, and politics is the last thing on their mind. But these folks may hold the fate of this election in their hands. The last time Mike Rogers ran for this seat, it came down to 20,217 votes. If it’s that close again, it’ll truly come down to these last-minute voters. MAGA Republicans are spending $157 million to try and bring those folks onto their side. We can’t outspend that, so our job is simple. Find every one of these undecided voters and make sure they: A. Have a plan to vote, and know where and when. B. Hear from us, so they'll vote in support of a campaign that's fighting for working people. That means organizers on the doors, volunteers on the phones, and our message on every screen we can reach. All of it costs money. I've never taken a dime from corporate PACs, so I'm not asking them. I'm asking you, Peter. Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can afford to help us reach every Michigander who still needs a plan to vote before Tuesday? Thank you for supporting our campaign in the final stretch. Your friend in the fight, Abdul

name: Voto Latino
subject: You have the right to vote.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
We’re texting voters across the country with the information they need to vote with confidence.
#
Peter,
**We’re just two days away from Election Day, and many in our community are worried about two things: discrimination and people suppressing their votes.**
That fear is real, and it’s exactly what the far right is counting on to keep Latino voters home. But every eligible voter has the right to cast their ballot free from intimidation, and knowing your rights is the best way to fight back.
That’s why Voto Latino is texting voters across the country with the information they need to vote with confidence — what their rights are at the polls, what to do if they feel intimidated, and where to get help in English and/or Spanish.
Here are 5 things you need to know about your voting rights.
1. You have a right to cast your ballot free from any intimidation.

2. You have a right to cast a provisional ballot.

3. You have a right to vote if you are in line before polls close.

4. You have a right to bring someone with you to the polling place if you need translation.

5. Each state has a different approach to mail ballots – verify your county election office’s eligibility requirements.

For help, reach out to the National Election Protection Hotline: 866-OUR-VOTE

name: Wes Moore
subject: A moment of reflection
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=2250%2E1086043%2EQ1ts5W)
Peter, we’re in the final hours of this re-election fight. I wanted to take a moment to reflect on how we got here, on my own story, and why it drives everything I do. But if you don’t have a lot of time, **[I would appreciate a donation of any amount right now.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261101-3.w_Q8Uz&refcode=em-20261101-3&t=2&akid=2250%2E1086043%2EQ1ts5W)**
My father died when I was three years old from a rare but treatable illness. He didn't get the health care he needed. My immigrant mother worked multiple jobs to raise three children on her own.
By 11, I had handcuffs on my wrists. What turned my life around were the people who refused to give up on me: my mother, and Valley Forge Military Academy. That’s where I learned that too many people had sacrificed for me, and too many people were rooting for me, for me to quit.
I became a soldier, deployed to Afghanistan with the 82nd Airborne, and led one of the largest poverty-fighting organizations in the country.
**Then I ran for governor -- because where you start in life should never determine how far you can go.**
In under four years, we’ve seen violent crime at record lows, test scores at five-year highs, and more than 64,000 new businesses. We’ve built a record of progress together, Peter.
But Maryland is not a safe blue state. National Republicans want this seat, and my MAGA Republican opponent, Dan Cox, would undo all our progress.
Together, we can win this and continue that progress. **[But I need your help. This campaign is powered by grassroots supporters like you. Will you chip in $5 to help us finish what we started?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20261101-3.w_Q8Uz&refcode=em-20261101-3&t=3&akid=2250%2E1086043%2EQ1ts5W)**

clean_body: | | | | Patriot, Don't go to sleep on election night wishing you did more. That's the standard our Turning Point Action team is holding itself to. Right now, they're all gas, no brakes, and I couldn't be more proud of them. Everything this team is doing is more than just showing up right before November, because that's not what actually wins elections. It's about building real connections while reaching voters where they are, in their neighborhoods. It takes years of preparation, with our door-knockers building relationships and earning trust. This is what my husband built Turning Point Action to do. Charlie wanted voting to become a habit for every America-loving patriot in this country, and our team is making that dream a reality, one front door at a time. Here's a look at what our team is doing on the ground right now: ✅ Hosting over 500 Super Chase events nationwide up until Election Day, activating people to chase votes in their own communities. ✅ Training and deploying 850+ full-time ballot chasers across key states, with the number increasing by the day. ✅ Making sure voters in key states have a plan to submit their vote, through the work of our Chase the Vote team. ✅ Working day and night at headquarters so our field teams have everything they need to identify and reach every possible voter. ✅ Calling, texting, and writing postcards to voters, and hosting community events to get out the vote. ✅ Developing the "Freedom Ticket" as a personalized voter guide for patriots to use at the voting booth in key battlegrounds. ✅ Building permanent infrastructure in the new "Red Wall" states of Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire. When I see this machine at work, I see Charlie's vision growing stronger across America. There's not much time left for our ballot chasers to reach every voter they can. I'm inviting you to join them in this final push across the finish line. Thank you for standing with the Turning Point family. Let's do the work to win. Last week a polling firm asked Americans about a tech CEO named Marshall Ancoates. He does not exist. He was invented by PF Global as a control. Twenty-two percent of the country pegged him as a Republican anyway, against 18 percent who guessed Democrat -- and Trump 2024 voters went 30-to-19 for the Republican. Harris voters split evenly, at 24.
Sit with that. A fictional executive acquired a party affiliation from thin air, and the affiliation everyone reached for was red. The electorate is no longer reading tech executives. It is reading a category, and the category has been painted.
The paint is mostly one man's. Elon Musk is read Republican by 59 percent of Americans -- and unlike everyone else on the list, he earned it, putting at least $276 million into Republican causes in a single quarter, by far the largest spender of the cycle. That is a real fact. It is also a fact about one man, and it has bleached across an entire industry that does not share his ledger.

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: Hey
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tammy Baldwin for Senate
body:
Don’t get pulled into the noise. Lock in. Focus on one thing: getting every Democrat in Michigan to the polls on Tuesday.
Peter, there's a lot of noise out there right now. We can’t be distracted.
Some people would love for the last days of this race to be about politicians. Who said what. Who's mad at whom. Screenshots and hot takes.
**I will not be distracted.** Every minute spent talking about politicians is a minute taken from the people this election is really about: working Michiganders.
— This election is about the dad I met who told me his kid is really good at baseball but can't play next year because he just can't afford it.
— This election is about everyone who's been told to wait for relief to “trickle down” while groceries, rent, and healthcare slip further out of reach.
— And it's about people far beyond our state. Because Michigan will decide control of the United States Senate. A Democratic Senate is how we put a check on Donald Trump's power. Mike Rogers, Trump's handpicked candidate, wants to be one more vote for the same billionaire agenda that's been fleecing Michigan for decades.
Please don’t get distracted by the political drama. I promise you I won’t.
Election Day is Tuesday. Several polls show us statistically tied with Mike Rogers. In 2024, the Senate race here came down to 20,217 votes.
**I’m told there's still time to put our final get-out-the-vote ads in front of Michigan voters, but only if we have the cash to run them right now.**
**[Please split a donation of $5 or any amount right now to fund Tammy Baldwin and our last get-out-the-vote ads before polls close on Tuesday.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20261101-elsayed.0EI4X2&amount=5&refcode=em20261101-5798&t=1&akid=5798%2E35263%2Ea-Nc8t)**

Let them have the drama. Let us earn the votes.
Abdul

name: James Carville
subject: Don’t let this one get away from us:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I’ve watched too many Senate races slip away in the final 2 days. Not this one.
Hi. It's James Carville, and I’ll be straight with you: **I’m sweating this race like a glass of iced tea on a July porch.**
The election is 2 days away. TWO. I’ve been in this business long enough to know that the last 2 days are when Senate races are won or when they slip away while good people are still meaning to get around to helping.
**[If you’ve been waiting to chip in to Chris Pappas, I’m asking you to do it right now. Not tomorrow. Right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261101_4.vQW5Xk&refcode=em20261101-4&t=1&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)**
**[Donate »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261101_4.vQW5Xk&amount=25&refcode=em20261101-4&t=2&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)**
Here’s what we’re up against. Republicans are spending **$67 million** to take this seat. Those Sununus have been running New Hampshire politics like a family business for more than forty years. John Sununu’s daddy was governor. His brother was governor. Now John wants his old Senate seat back, even though Granite Staters showed him the door in 2008.
National Republicans know exactly what this race means. New Hampshire is a Democratic-held seat. If they flip it, there’s no path to a Democratic Senate majority. If Democrats hold it, we may just flip the Senate.
Chris Pappas has won the toughest district in New Hampshire **_four damn times_**. He knows how to close. But closing costs money: ads in the final stretch, mail hitting doors, organizers knocking from Nashua to the North Country. Every dollar that comes in this week will be spent before Election Day. A dollar that shows up after November 3rd doesn’t win us a damn thing.
**[So here’s my ask: $10, $25, $50, whatever you can spare, to support Chris Pappas today.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261101_4.vQW5Xk&refcode=em20261101-4&t=3&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)**
**[Donate »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261101_4.vQW5Xk&amount=5&refcode=em20261101-4&t=4&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)**
I’ve sat in too many rooms on election night watching a race we should’ve won slip away by a few thousand votes. Every time, somebody says, “If we’d just had a little more at the end.” We can’t let that happen in New Hampshire.
**[In a race this close, the dollar you give today might be the difference, and I’m not exaggerating. Chip in $25 now, and help Chris finish this race strong.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261101_4.vQW5Xk&amount=25&refcode=em20261101-4&t=5&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261101_4.vQW5Xk&amount=5&refcode=em20261101-4&t=24&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)**
Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.
– James Carville
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261101_4.vQW5Xk&refcode=em20261101-4&t=25&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)
**P.S.** Two days. If you’ve been meaning to give to this race, this is the moment. **[Chip in $5 >>](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261101_4.vQW5Xk&amount=5&refcode=em20261101-4&t=26&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)**
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer?refcode=em20261101-4&t=27&refcode2=9885_582294_9FuIQ6&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)**
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.chrispappas.org/signup/cps_receive_fewer_emails/?t=28&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)
* [Update Your Information](https://act.chrispappas.org/signup/cps_update_your_information/?t=29&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)
* [Unsubscribe](https://act.chrispappas.org/unsubscribe/cps_unsubscribe/?t=30&akid=9885%2E582294%2E9FuIQ6)

Dear Friends, Family, and Supporters,

As Election Day approaches, thank you for your incredible support and dedication to our movement for independent representation!

We need your help to finish strong:

* Spread the Word: Keep texting friends and family, sharing on social media, and passing along our Campaign Flyer & Sample Ballot: [<https://shorturl.at/EicEdy](https://shorturl.at/EicEdy)>

If you can cover a shift on Tuesday, text Jay or Charles' team at 757-733-5989 to meet up and pick up your print materials.

Thank you for standing with us!

With gratitude,
Jay, Charles, and the Campaign Team

Patriot,

Most of what we send you is strategy: states, numbers, the plan to win. This one is about why we do this work at all. And that starts with Charlie Kirk.

Charlie launched Turning Point in the shadows of the Obama re-election campaign headquarters in Chicago. He was 18 years old.

Every established political force on the Left and the Right tried to stop him.

They failed.

What Charlie started grew into what is **the most influential activist organization in modern American history**.

We were privileged to work with him and be a part of this movement.

We joined Charlie because we believed our mission was the only viable way to save this country. Charlie was willing to do what nobody else in the conservative movement would do. He went looking for young Americans who cared enough about this country to act, and he gave them a reason to fight.

Then came 2020...

Under President Biden, we saw corruption, weaponization of the government, and a government promoting values that put Americans last.

Charlie was adamant that we do everything we could possibly do to fix this in 2024. **We DID IT** , and we must continue for 2026 and 2028 to have a shot at saving this country.

Now, it is on us to continue Charlie's vision and mission.

Every single day, we work to continue his legacy of recruiting, training, and mobilizing a new generation of citizens who love this country enough to do something about it.

That work does not stop at the campus gates. It's now changing the direction of the nation.

Right now, ballot chasers supported by Turning Point PAC are in the field in **states that will determine not just 2026, but the 2028 Presidential election**.

They are meeting voters face to face. They are building real relationships in these communities. They are chasing every ballot, whether it's cast on Election Day or by mail.

This is how we build the Red Wall.

Election Day is November 3rd.

body:
In Texas, there’s no limit on what one billionaire can give.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, Elon Musk gave Greg Abbott $5 million.
[_****_](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261102_1_musk.D-DOIE&refcode=em20261101-2608&amount=5&t=2&akid=2608%2E299639%2E0qB-HY)
**In Texas, there are no limits on how much one person can give to a campaign.** None. So one billionaire can write a $5 million check to keep Greg Abbott in power, and that’s exactly what he did.
**We have to respond right away.**
[**Will you chip in $15 now to help us fight back against Elon Musk’s $5 million?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1374?c0=em_ms_gh_20261102_1_musk.NeV5EW&refcode=em20261101-2608&t=4&akid=2608%2E299639%2E0qB-HY)
That money doesn’t sit in a bank account. In the final stretch of this race, it turns into more TV ads, more paid canvassers knocking on doors, more billboards on every highway in this state. All of it aimed at drowning out the people of Texas who are ready for change.
This is an all-hands-on-deck moment, and I’m counting on people like you, not billionaires, to power this campaign.
[**Will you make your first contribution to this campaign right now? Even $15 will help us fight back against Elon Musk’s $5 million.**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1374?c0=em_ms_gh_20261102_1_musk.NeV5EW&refcode=em20261101-2608&t=6&akid=2608%2E299639%2E0qB-HY)

Elon Musk thinks he can buy this election. Let’s show him that Texans can’t be bought.

Gina

Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth broke barriers in 2024, becoming the youngest woman ever elected to Congress from Maryland. She went to Congress with one thing in mind: delivering for Maryland families on the issues that matter most. Whether it's standing up for federal workers, supporting veterans, protecting the Chesapeake Bay, or tackling the affordability crisis head-on, Sarah is on the front lines, fighting for what is right. She has spent her first year in the House advocating for the Third District, successfully passing five bills into law, solving over 1,000 constituent cases, and bringing tens of millions in funding back to her community. She learned her work ethic and tenacity from growing up in a union household and honed her skills of problem-solving and collaborating over six years in the Maryland State Senate. Sarah lives in Annapolis with her husband, Eric, and their dog, Ollie. name: Mark Kelly
subject: My decision:
body:
Hey folks,
it’s Mark Kelly.

Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run
for the Senate.

I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of
time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.

But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing
just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I
had to do something.

So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run
all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support,
we won that one, too.

I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and
defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the
greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be
here without your help.

I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different.
With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have
ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.

After everything that’s already happened, I wish I didn’t have to ask you
for more. But that’s what I need to do.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261101_2.lH9fIm&refcode=em20261101-2&t=1001&akid=9883%2E582294%2Es7rpDX ]I’m asking you to split a donation between Chris Pappas and me. We’re
going to do everything we can to take back Congress this November, and
Chris Pappas needs your help. I just hope you know that I wouldn’t be
asking if this wasn’t important.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261101_2.lH9fIm&amount=5&refcode=em20261101-2&t=1020&akid=9883%2E582294%2Es7rpDX ]Donate $5 »

Thank you.

Mark

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261101_2.lH9fIm&refcode=em20261101-2&t=1021&akid=9883%2E582294%2Es7rpDX ][IMG]

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:

body:
[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/24838?t=1001&akid=2145%2E181023%2EDH25gf ][IMG]

The finish
line is in sight.

We now have just two days left to reach the last few undecided voters with
our message, rally our supporters up and down the state, and do everything
we can to finish this campaign strong.

As someone who’s run over 40 marathons, I know that when you make it to
the last mile, you don’t slow down — you do the exact opposite.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/24838?t=1002&akid=2145%2E181023%2EDH25gf ]I’m going all gas, no brakes for these final two days, making sure that
every last Michigander hears my plan to make our state a place where
everyone can afford to live and thrive. But I can’t win in a swing

Hi there, it's Michele Tafoya!

If I were to take a guess, there's a 50/50 chance you may recognize me from a stadium's big screen.
If that's not the case, I get it... Let me at least tell you briefly about who I am and what I'm about anyway!

I should clarify first, no, I didn't make my career running for touchdowns or kicking game-winning field goals.

I worked as a sideline reporter in professional football for nearly three decades. Working in the sport for that long was a dream come true, and I wouldn't have wanted it any other way.
[Believe me, I know plenty of people who called me crazy for walking away from a career I loved. That’s why they’re ready to do — and spend — whatever it takes to cling to power. A child's ZIP code should tell us where they live. It should not tell us how little we expect them to achieve.
Yet too often, when children struggle to read, the explanations arrive faster than the solutions. Poverty. Family circumstances. Funding. Another study. Another committee. Racism?
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2768453d-e857-4d20-b8ea-9a63f5759e1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Meanwhile, childhood does not pause.
▶️ **[Watch the forum here.](https://substack.com/redirect/2768453d-e857-4d20-b8ea-9a63f5759e1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
We brought together educators, policy experts, pastors, parents, and community voices because improving education requires people willing to work across those lines.
Parents need answers they can act on. Educators need approaches that help children learn. And communities need to insist that children's potential matters more than adults' attachment to the way things have always been done.
**We cannot prepare children for the opportunities of tomorrow while accepting that they cannot read today.**
Artificial intelligence is accelerating. Work is changing. New opportunities are emerging. Our children deserve the preparation to take their share of that future.
Literacy is where that preparation begins.
**Watch the conversation. Then share it with a parent, teacher, pastor, school board member, or neighbor.** Ask them: What should we put into practice--and how can we help?
**[Watch"Can Philadelphia Become the Next Mississippi Miracle?"](https://substack.com/redirect/2768453d-e857-4d20-b8ea-9a63f5759e1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
And leave a comment: **What is one change you believe would make the greatest difference for Philadelphia 's children?**
Thank you to everyone who participated, attended, and supported this forum. Let's keep the conversation moving toward action.
Blessings...
Let's get to work!

body:
Florida deserves better than this.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20261101-2&t=1&akid=4213%2E587540%2E9_TiMl)
Peter, Angie Nixon here.
Republicans have controlled Florida for years, and they cannot hold that much power while pretending they bear no responsibility for what working families are experiencing: grocery bills that keep climbing, rent and insurance eating up paychecks, childcare families can't afford, and healthcare that costs too much.
**[Can you split $5 between Leaders We Deserve and me right now to help change that on Election Day?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20261101_2_angie.jcssr7&refcode=em20261101-4213&amount=5&t=2&akid=4213%2E587540%2E9_TiMl)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20261101_2_angie.jcssr7&amount=5&refcode=em20261101-4213&t=3&akid=4213%2E587540%2E9_TiMl)**
Here's what Republicans understand about me, and why it scares them. I just shocked the political establishment by winning the Democratic nomination despite being dramatically outspent, proving that people-powered organizing can beat big money.
I'm a working-class Black woman who isn't going to Washington to protect wealthy donors or preserve the status quo. I've been clear about why I'm running: I want government to work for working people instead of the wealthy and powerful interests that have dominated Washington and Tallahassee.
The wealthy and powerful keep getting richer while working people are told to make do with less. This campaign exists to ask the question at the center of this race: who is the government working for, the people working to pay the bills, or the wealthy few writing the checks?
**[With Election Day closing in, can you split $10, $25, or whatever you can between Leaders We Deserve and me to help elect leaders who answer to voters?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20261101_2_angie.jcssr7&refcode=em20261101-4213&amount=5&t=4&akid=4213%2E587540%2E9_TiMl)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20261101_2_angie.jcssr7&amount=5&refcode=em20261101-4213&t=23&akid=4213%2E587540%2E9_TiMl)**
Their track record got us here. Let's give Florida a different one.

# [](https://act.janepac.com/go/30?t=1&akid=14%2E6803%2EMHFETL)
As we approach the final two days before Election Day, I want to start off by saying **thank you.**
Because of you, we’ve built an unstoppable movement of climate fighters—one that will outlast whatever happens on Tuesday. Whether you chipped in five bucks, signed petitions to protect our public lands, knocked doors, or talked to neighbors about what's at stake, you showed up when it mattered most.
Thank you again.
Come Tuesday, we have a real shot at celebrating historic wins in the most consequential races for our climate and our democracy. Here’s what I’m watching closely as final votes are cast:
**In Pennsylvania:** Mark Pinsley, Eileen Hartnett Albillar, Chris Thomas, and Brian Wrightson are in tight battles to flip red State Senate districts and secure a Democratic majority for the first time in over 30 years.
**In Wisconsin:** Robyn Vining, Trevor Jung, and Jenna Jacobson are taking on massive waves of dark money to flip state legislative seats and put power back in the hands of the people.
**In Georgia and Florida:** Peter Hubbard and Shelia Edwards are running for the Public Service Commission to hold utility monopolies accountable, while in Florida, Jennifer Jenkins and Angie Nixon are putting seats on the map for Congress and the U.S. Senate that were once written off.
**In Texas:** Clayton Tucker and Gina Hinojosa are going toe-to-toe with fossil fuel giants in the very heart of oil and gas country. Gina could unseat oil-money-lover Greg Abbott in the Texas governor’s race.
**In California and Michigan:** Randy Villegas and Will Lawrence are in two of the most competitive congressional races this year. They’ve made their entire campaigns about putting working people over the corporations who’ve sold us out.
This is a winner-takes-all moment. There is no second place. Big Oil, Elon Musk, and Trump-aligned super PACs are dumping everything they have into buying these seats at the eleventh hour. But our candidates don't rely on them — **they rely on you.**
**[We’ve come too far to slow down now. The next 48 hours are our final chance to make a difference. Will you please rush a $5 donation before polls close?](https://act.janepac.com/go/9?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261101-ak.f1aVBD&amount=5&refcode=em20261101-14&t=3&akid=14%2E6803%2EMHFETL)**

Thank you for refusing to back down.
In solidarity,
xx Jane

body:
I don’t often write personal messages like this, and I hate to add another message to your inbox, but honestly, I need all the help I can get this year.

| I don’t often write personal messages like this, and I hate to add another message to your inbox, but honestly, I need all the help I can get this year.
I bet you get dozens of texts and emails a day questioning your GOP loyalty, threatening you, or even making you pay to take a poll on voter ID. I promise to never do that to you.
I’m taking the time to write this because I want to be perfectly honest about what's at stake this year.
So here it is, no flashy colors, donation buttons, or fake matches.
I hope you’ll read this entire message.
---
From: Congressman Gabe Evans
First and foremost, thank you.
I've been a lot of things in life: an Army Black Hawk helicopter pilot, a rancher, and a cop.
But never in a million years did I think I'd have the honor of fighting for our Conservative movement in Congress.
Your support has gotten me where I am today, and I never take that for granted.
But it wasn't some cakewalk.
I ran for Congress in deep-blue Colorado, where Republicans hadn't flipped a Democrat-held seat in over a decade.
Against all odds, I won and became the voice for thousands of Conservatives stuck under the thumb of Radical Democrat rule.
It's not a responsibility I take lightly.
My race was decided by just 2,500 votes and was one of the most expensive House races in the country in 2024.
Now, just two years later, Democrats are looking for their revenge.
[](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW10cG9zaXRpb249MyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjExMDFfRUQtUUUuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDc5NjkyLTkyMDImdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYxMTAxX0VELVFFLjExMDExN190MjA3OTY5Mi05MjAyIn0/5dhEICS_SWb0VvqE0dfzAw)They've already poured millions into this race and are planning an ad blitz to bury my campaign and drown out my message with lies and smears.
They want people to forget what happened when they were in charge.
Under the control of Radical Democrats, we saw illegal immigrants pouring in by the tens of thousands, crime spiraling out of control, and even armed Venezuelan gang members taking over apartment complexes at gunpoint.
As a former cop, watching that happen in my community broke me.
I know how Democrats run things, and I know we can never go back.
Unfortunately, my seat is one of the Democrats' TOP TARGETS, and polling shows this race is a true toss-up that could be decided by even fewer votes than last time.
That's why I'm writing to you today.
Because you're all I've got to help fend off the Democrats' money machine.
The only way I can keep this seat red is with the support of Patriots like you.
[Could you help me keep this seat red by pitching in anything you can today?](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW10cG9zaXRpb249My8_YW10cG9zaXRpb249MyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjExMDFfRUQtUUUuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDc5NjkyLTkyMDImdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYxMTAxX0VELVFFLjExMDExN190MjA3OTY5Mi05MjAyIn0/M4LJ2sXadbtyaW_Abi11ag)
Remember, this seat was decided by just 2,500 votes. That's about 1%.
Democrats know the key to taking back the House Majority runs through seats like mine, and they're prepared to spend whatever it takes to flip them.
I can't match their millions on my own.
But with enough Patriots standing together, we can beat them again.
So if you're able to give today, I would be incredibly grateful.
[You can use this secure link to pitch in and help this retired Army vet stay in Congress.](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado._bW9uZXlfcGxlZGdlPXRydWUmcmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW10cG9zaXRpb249MyZleF90aWQ9MjAyNjExMDFfRUQtUUUuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDc5NjkyLTkyMDImdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYxMTAxX0VELVFFLjExMDExN190MjA3OTY5Mi05MjAyIn0/G74-GIFu-Bi0UxmSNrKUnA)
Thank you for standing with me.
Congressman Gabe Evans (CO-08)

Peter, it’s Governor Wes Moore. I will work with anybody. **_But I will bow to nobody_**. I didn’t come from money or prestige. As the son of an immigrant single mother, I came from hard work, community, and an unshakeable belief that _we could do better_. [If you share that belief, would you split a donation of $10 between our re-election campaign and the Democratic Party of Georgia today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142666914/657651601/1183156290?amount=10&source=DPG_EM_FR_110126_B1_MooreSplit_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NDEwZmMwMi0wMWQ2LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=C_5fxuidBTCkQkgxGiIjTtQ6xToWvS9ifXdVQBg-sqA=) Peter, my grandfather was run out of his home by the Klan. **But he rebuilt anyway.** That history and resilience is why I believe every family deserves a fair shot at work, wages, and wealth — not just survival. Wednesday morning, early, state investigators came for the mayor of Kissimmee. By midday there was a booking photo -- glasses, neutral expression, the genre's uniform. By two o'clock, Florida's attorney general stood at a podium in Orlando beside the state's chief financial officer and the FDLE commissioner to announce that Mayor Jackie Espinosa, fifty-eight, the first Hispanic woman to hold the office by local accounts, was charged with one count of grand theft -- $20,000 to $100,000, a second-degree felony carrying up to fifteen years -- and one count of organized scheme to defraud. Her lawyer says she maintains her innocence, and that is where the law properly begins: an arrest is an allegation wearing handcuffs.
But the warrant tells a larger story than one mayor. It tells you how political crime gets cleaned up in 2026 -- not at the ballot box, but before it.

Friends,
With early voting underway in Kansas and Election Day just days away, Roger Marshall is _panicking_. After all, Roll Call named him one of the most vulnerable senators in the country and _multiple_ election experts have switched this race from a safe seat to a toss-up.
And you know what? He should be anxious. After turning his back on Kansans and consistently voting to make their lives harder and more expensive, people are fed up. They’re ready for a leader who will listen to them and work to solve their problems, not be a yes-man to a party and an administration that doesn’t put hardworking Kansas families first.
But Sen. Marshall has what he’s hoping is an ace up his sleeve: **President Trump is returning to Kansas today to hold another rally supporting Marshall.**
The president coming here again so close to Election Day is proof that Washington insiders are worried. _They know people are fed up, they know our grassroots movement is surging and they know we have what it takes to win._
**But folks, I’m worried too.** When the president rallies for someone, big money often follows. Top GOP super PACs have already spent nearly $40 million on this race, and after today, they’re almost certainly going to pour even more resources into defeating us.
**They’re pulling out all the stops because they know that, unlike me, Roger Marshall is a yes-man for party bosses. He’s spent a decade in Washington rubber-stamping the policies his party has told him to support, even when those policies hurt the people he was elected to represent.**
In the past year alone, he’s voted to slash the healthcare assistance that thousands of Kansans rely on, supported Medicaid cuts that have put 28 rural hospitals at risk of closing, backed a war that’s driven diesel prices to record highs and signed off on the tariffs that cost Kansans hundreds of dollars every month.
**Now, the establishment is going all out to save this seat for him so he can keep putting Washington insiders over Kansans.**
Look, the reality is that we have what it takes to retire Roger Marshall. If we didn’t, the president wouldn’t be coming back to try and rescue him. But that doesn’t change the fact that Marshall and his allies continue to outspend us at an alarming rate. They’re blanketing the airwaves with attack ads against me — and if we can’t find a way to keep up, we may lose the chance to defeat Marshall and flip this seat.
I know Kansans are ready for change. I know their enthusiasm for better leadership — leadership that actually fights for _them_ — is surging. But if we can’t keep ads on the air and fund our get-out-the-vote efforts, we’ll lose ground in this critical moment ... and we won’t have time to make it up.
**My team and I have set a rapid-response goal to raise $250,000 to help us meet this moment. That’s what it will take to respond to the escalated attacks that are coming. clean_body: We can send Marshall packing, but we can’t do it alone. | | | = Friends, With early voting underway in Kansas and Election Day just days away, Roger Marshall is panicking. After all, Roll Call named him one of the most vulnerable senators in the country and multiple election experts have switched this race from a safe seat to a toss-up. And you know what? He should be anxious. After turning his back on Kansans and consistently voting to make their lives harder and more expensive, people are fed up. They’re ready for a leader who will listen to them and work to solve their problems, not be a yes-man to a party and an administration that doesn’t put hardworking Kansas families first. But Sen. Marshall has what he’s hoping is an ace up his sleeve: President Trump is returning to Kansas today to hold another rally supporting Marshall. The president coming here again so close to Election Day is proof that Washington insiders are worried. They know people are fed up, they know our grassroots movement is surging and they know we have what it takes to win. But folks, I’m worried too. When the president rallies for someone, big money often follows. Top GOP super PACs have already spent nearly $40 million on this race, and after today, they’re almost certainly going to pour even more resources into defeating us. They’re pulling out all the stops because they know that, unlike me, Roger Marshall is a yes-man for party bosses. He’s spent a decade in Washington rubber-stamping the policies his party has told him to support, even when those policies hurt the people he was elected to represent. In the past year alone, he’s voted to slash the healthcare assistance that thousands of Kansans rely on, supported Medicaid cuts that have put 28 rural hospitals at risk of closing, backed a war that’s driven diesel prices to record highs and signed off on the tariffs that cost Kansans hundreds of dollars every month. Now, the establishment is going all out to save this seat for him so he can keep putting Washington insiders over Kansans. Look, the reality is that we have what it takes to retire Roger Marshall. If we didn’t, the president wouldn’t be coming back to try and rescue him. But that doesn’t change the fact that Marshall and his allies continue to outspend us at an alarming rate. It's not just a far-fetched hypothetical anymore.
A new explosive report from Axios reveals that Trump's top allies are openly discussing martial law if MAGA loses big in the upcoming midterm elections.
On a livestream for MAGA election activists, Trump's childhood friend and attorney, Peter Ticktin, said it plainly: "There would have to be martial law in the event... [of] another rigged election."
He did not stop there. He told Axios that officials need to commandeer ballots and voting machines. Another speaker on the same call said he wants the election paused entirely. A third floated using emergency powers to force states to change how they count votes.

Tina Peters, who was convicted of crimes tied to breaching election equipment, met with Trump privately in the Oval Office this month. She and Ticktin were both at the White House in June.

That is why it is up to our courts to stop him. The Constitution is clear: states run elections, not the feds. And when Trump comes for our ballots, state courts will be the first and last line of defense against his coup.

You know, back home in Jackson, we’ve got a saying: You find out who’s really in your corner when the road gets tough. _**Peter**_ , you’ve been in my corner every single mile of this haul. Peter, With just 2 days left before Election Day, we’re in the most important stretch of our campaign. Right now, our amazing team of supporters and volunteers are talking with voters all across NY-16 during these final days of GOTV. They’re knocking on doors, making phone calls, and meeting New Yorkers where they are – because every conversation in this final stretch makes all the difference. In these final hours, we have to mobilize our base and persuade every remaining undecided voter. This election will decide our country’s future, so we refuse to leave anything to chance. Once the polls close on November 3rd, we won’t get a second chance. If we want to see a Democratic House majority, it starts by protecting this seat. After nearly two years representing this district in Congress it's hard to believe we're already this close to another Election Day.
I've been thinking a lot about what these past two years have meant to me.
When voters elected me in 2024, they gave me the responsibility of representing their families, their communities and their concerns in Washington.

Hi, it's Chris.
**We have less than 48 hours left in this campaign, and New Hampshire is on the line.**
John Sununu has taken the lead in the polls, thanks to over $67 million in GOP spending that's flooding the airwaves.
We're running out of time to close this fundraising gap and keep the Granite State blue.
**[Will you chip in $15 or whatever you can afford to boost our grassroots campaign in its final days and help us flip the Senate?](https://substack.com/redirect/a605042c-bece-4b3d-99df-2486342203c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/a605042c-bece-4b3d-99df-2486342203c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**When I first ran for Congress, I made the decision that I wouldn 't take a dime of corporate PAC money.**
Not because I thought it would make campaigns easier. And not because I believed everyone else had to make the same decision.
I made that commitment because I wanted Granite Staters to know exactly where my priorities would lie as their representative.
Granite Staters responded to that choice. They saw it was proof that I was serious about changing the culture in Washington.
New Hampshire is a purple state. Every race here is competitive. And over the years, I've heard more than a few people suggest that refusing corporate PAC money meant competing with one hand tied behind my back.
But four tough congressional races later, we've shown something important: You can build a winning campaign the right way.
**I believe public service is about serving the public.**
People deserve leaders who are accountable to the communities they represent - especially in this current moment.
Now we are facing our biggest test yet: Control of the Senate could come down to New Hampshire, and Republicans and their allies are spending millions of dollars to flip this seat.
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/a605042c-bece-4b3d-99df-2486342203c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Far-right billionaires, dark money groups, and organizations backed by Big Oil and Big Pharma are lining up behind John Sununu because they know what's at stake.
It wasn't always easy, but I still refuse to take a dime of corporate PAC money -- because independence matters. I answer to Granite Staters, not corporate PACs.
I want the people I represent to know that my focus will always be on lowering costs, protecting Social Security and Medicare, defending access to abortion, and making sure people who work hard have the opportunity to get ahead.
People deserve leaders who tell them the truth, fight for their priorities, and remember who sent them to Washington in the first place.
That's what I've tried to do throughout my time in Congress, and it's the same approach I'll bring to the U.S. Senate.
This campaign comes down to independence and making sure Granite Staters are always put first.
**[Chip in $15 or whatever makes sense for you right now to stand with our grassroots-powered campaign and keep us competitive in the final days of this race.](https://substack.com/redirect/a605042c-bece-4b3d-99df-2486342203c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Thank you,
Chris

clean_body: Hi, it's Chris. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more | | | Nov 1 | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi, it's Chris. We have less than 48 hours left in this campaign, and New Hampshire is on the line. John Sununu has taken the lead in the polls, thanks to over $67 million in GOP spending that's flooding the airwaves. We're running out of time to close this fundraising gap and keep the Granite State blue. When I first ran for Congress, I made the decision that I wouldn 't take a dime of corporate PAC money. Not because I thought it would make campaigns easier. And not because I believed everyone else had to make the same decision. I made that commitment because I wanted Granite Staters to know exactly where my priorities would lie as their representative. Granite Staters responded to that choice. They saw it was proof that I was serious about changing the culture in Washington. New Hampshire is a purple state. Every race here is competitive. And over the years, I've heard more than a few people suggest that refusing corporate PAC money meant competing with one hand tied behind my back. But four tough congressional races later, we've shown something important: You can build a winning campaign the right way. I believe public service is about serving the public. People deserve leaders who are accountable to the communities they represent - especially in this current moment. Now we are facing our biggest test yet: Control of the Senate could come down to New Hampshire, and Republicans and their allies are spending millions of dollars to flip this seat. Far-right billionaires, dark money groups, and organizations backed by Big Oil and Big Pharma are lining up behind John Sununu because they know what's at stake. It wasn't always easy, but I still refuse to take a dime of corporate PAC money -- because independence matters. I answer to Granite Staters, not corporate PACs. I want the people I represent to know that my focus will always be on lowering costs, protecting Social Security and Medicare, defending access to abortion, and making sure people who work hard have the opportunity to get ahead. People deserve leaders who tell them the truth, fight for their priorities, and remember who sent them to Washington in the first place. That's what I've tried to do throughout my time in Congress, and it's the same approach I'll bring to the U.S. Senate. This campaign comes down to independence and making sure Granite Staters are always put first. Thank you, Chris | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Chris Pappas PO Box 313, Manchester, NH 03105 ? ?

Case File No DRT-ED-IRAN · Special File · Behind the Strikes
Eight Months After the First U.S. Strikes on Iran, the Strait of Hormuz Is Still Shut. The Explosions Were Only the Visible Part.
Operation Epic Fury began on February 28. Since then there have been ceasefires, a U.S. naval blockade, renewed strikes in July and a strait that remains effectively closed. Brent crude settled near $114 on October 27. Wars this large are rarely about only one thing.
Threat level 4/5 — Elevated

|

Most coverage of the Iran war follows the bombs: where they fell, what they hit, who fired back. Far less attention goes to what the conflict is changing underneath: who controls energy routes, which currencies get used and which resources suddenly matter more to Washington.
The evidence board
| | What We Know
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the start.** U.S. and Israeli forces launched strikes on Iran on February 28, 2026. Within weeks, Iran was attacking Gulf states and choking traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the blockade.** A two-week ceasefire was announced on April 7, but Iran closed the strait again the next day. On April 13, President Trump announced a naval blockade of Iranian ports.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — round two.** In July, the U.S. launched fresh strikes after Tehran said it had closed the strait again.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit D — the price.** Brent settled at $113.88 a barrel on October 27, near six-month highs, as peace talks continued without a deal.
| OUR THEORY
---
When a war drags on this long, the stakes usually go beyond the battlefield. Follow the money, and the real objectives start to come into view.

They could break ground the same day.
#
Peter —
In November 1963, just days after John F. Kennedy was assassinated — and hours before his funeral — First Lady Jacqueline Kennedy had one request: She wanted to add an eternal flame to his gravesite that could be seen by everyone.
Overnight, a team of United States Army Corps of Engineers went to work to build the eternal flame next to his grave. The First Lady lit a candle and brought the flame to life the next day, which has been burning in Arlington National Cemetery for more than 60 years.

Friends, here's what the last week of this race looks like for me versus my opponent.
As Sen. Marshall calls in backup from President Trump and VP Vance and doubles down on his smear campaign, we're going back to the basics: **hopping on a bus and traveling across Kansas to** _**actually listen**_**to folks.**
That's the core promise of my campaign. The truth is, I'm not a career politician. I'm not interested in Washington's political games. But I do know one thing: The most important job of a senator is to listen to Kansans and fight for what's best for them. I've spent my whole career as a pastor listening to people from all walks of life -- Republicans, Democrats and independents alike. That's why I'm stopping everywhere I can across Kansas in the final days of this race.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f2fee947-d02d-4b59-9f0c-771815f6c5f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

In Olathe, I heard from small-business owners struggling to make ends meet under reckless tariffs and another war. They feel left behind by Washington insiders who stopped listening to Kansans long ago.
**Folks everywhere are fired up and ready for a new kind of leadership, grounded in decency and a commitment to fight for working people, not corporate PACs or party bosses.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f2fee947-d02d-4b59-9f0c-771815f6c5f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Along the way, I stopped for a town hall in Oakley. Nearly 20 months ago, Sen. Marshall walked out of a similar town hall here and called the Kansans there "dangerous."
I took a different approach: I sat down and listened.
The truth is, I don't always agree on everything with the people I talk to -- after all, Kansas is a place full of differing opinions. But I'm committed to listening to folks -- even when they see things a little differently. That's the bare minimum we should be able to expect from our leaders.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f2fee947-d02d-4b59-9f0c-771815f6c5f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Meeting Kansans on the road in this final stretch is so important, but it's only half of the battle.
**While I 'm out campaigning, Roger Marshall and his allies in D.C. are busy too -- pulling out all the stops to crush our momentum at the eleventh hour with attack ads and outright lies about me. We're so close to the finish line -- but while I'm on the road, we also need to make sure our ads stay on air until the last ballots are cast AND fully fund our get-out-the-vote efforts.**
**[If you're ready to send a champion for Kansas to Washington this Tuesday -- and if you're able to spare a few dollars -- will you rush a donation to our campaign today?](https://substack.com/redirect/f2fee947-d02d-4b59-9f0c-771815f6c5f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Kansas is thousands of miles away from the extreme politics of Washington. We're smack-dab in the middle of the country. And I'll lead from the middle, too. Because it's time to heal the divisiveness in our politics -- and it's beyond time to finally deliver results for hardworking Kansans.
Now, let's finish strong and win! I'm counting on you to have my back until the very end.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/f2fee947-d02d-4b59-9f0c-771815f6c5f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you for being on board,
Adam

Hi there, it's Michele Tafoya!

If I were to take a guess, there's a 50/50 chance you may recognize me from a stadium's big screen.
If that's not the case, I get it... Let me at least tell you briefly about who I am and what I'm about anyway!

I should clarify first, no, I didn't make my career running for touchdowns or kicking game-winning field goals.

I worked as a sideline reporter in professional football for nearly three decades. Working in the sport for that long was a dream come true, and I wouldn't have wanted it any other way.
[Believe me, I know plenty of people who called me crazy for walking away from a career I loved. But life is short, and I was not willing to sit on the sidelines while everything I care about was on the line.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=06d5ac2a00df47719290639d71e7d1db&_e=jql-uDUJx0-sdLv3ZWYLs4FXYZHCUnSEESoASzzRuKVRZiTVaz3jy6oPs1YySpSZvGMvFB3Sr9bKkrX914apjc-g2UvL3UTO-aqigbsamWMc4fH-LoZvAySUS3sAgvkSHJZMyY2U3dNlE3p8JKUeP8moxs_Ge_KXDmNRj8SJvrDz-PB26keYepFR5HZXY6xtmiHD58D6rlHEEF-LUvYZIO88GAeeEh-3eAtYqCvtWNoZapDNcANqLx0eAzCPRMHBeOeaHi1nSamHNelTwEGMyTYnjIXr8Ifo3vT99Fl25TF1ucO2xOrAmz-07NXK6rFgFWkEs_35ByYNB-5qaC_XmsP7dPXDYwYfw8ot8OMbg_IcaZwltHgR_HOOGAxeaXZfcMaA4j1UWQU0x9KrgvSmnQZooX-T3riuYr7v5Igml_3y0y_S6S_PuTwZ_IFyOx-5Rg9K8mzDVjIFcRzyjU5r2rjlETTIhaZ4Y4vD_eHnr7Ky_Ha3qbPQWFSqO6nVKzi35VkQgQynKbDT4upzCUd5AEcf03bYLsPSICLfvWbqLJ4z4UXRgH_izIxQ37_CDzKzgZDAkFyUpaOle9ar7KoFFDu6mj7uy0b833YSfU-aAVrCnqFuN1VNB_whzKNLLJADLkVVZPJ721cFFaYWeN6fiFV1dlPQvQXn6fHTOlss6e1dxMn8mXu90xr82hKxsxSqXhogRU9NoyUFKfD-DiQb7uevPNsBejbluanT9di_VGGVYNWstyd32FFhUsvbJ3TU7UBY-VoPAqpDAqwO8exoqu3dPibBM3aSeZVMlmPufS2T2CadqtSRfPa3mUAKKU1WKvtdyFCm3xIqLvXeHGVSzEmieg3SEHW1iYfLSP8rB5EB2mOnagWDxWgcp7Jg-bQOcNrgTKYmZOxtTHy-6_83nYDhC0JVB1g0vTWhupvJ4qxQMVK1MbWX0Q_1_NAoQHjumHN5chZxa5hYdLyV_p_ezcohiZnp_20MOsYLlQyG5pEgICm5eiFXlgMtp8cWQ5B1)
I told myself before I officially launched my race for U.S. Senate that we had to be all in or not do it at all.

I burned the boats, Patriot, and there's absolutely no looking back.
I will not be canceled. I will not apologize for values that are wholesome and good. And if my voice gives someone else the courage to use theirs, that is exactly why I did it.

I want my daughter and every young American to know one thing:
You earn your place. You think for yourself. And you never let anyone put you in a box. That's the Minnesota I'm fighting for.
Parents who speak up are called transphobes.Girls who lose opportunities are told to be quiet.And women's groups are nowhere to be found.
This is not complicated.
Girls' sports are for girls, and boys' sports are for boys.

The radical Left has done everything in its power to infiltrate some of the most vulnerable minds in our society. I launched this run because just like you, I'm sick of the indoctrination and want to bring back sanity to our country.

It's going to be FAR from easy. Minnesota hasn't had a Republican Senator in nearly two decades! However, it's ripe for a flip....with the disastrous leadership of Governor Walz and the Democratic Party in the state, people are fed up.

It's going to take a grassroots army of patriots, just like you, to propel this movement of ours to victory and shock the world.

clean_body: I walked away from EVERYTHING for this: | Hi there, it's Michele Tafoya! If I were to take a guess, there's a 50/50 chance you may recognize me from a stadium's big screen. If that's not the case, I get it... Let me at least tell you briefly about who I am and what I'm about anyway! I should clarify first, no, I didn't make my career running for touchdowns or kicking game-winning field goals. I worked as a sideline reporter in professional football for nearly three decades. Working in the sport for that long was a dream come true, and I wouldn't have wanted it any other way. I told myself before I officially launched my race for U.S. Senate that we had to be all in or not do it at all. I burned the boats, Patriot, and there's absolutely no looking back. I will not be canceled. I will not apologize for values that are wholesome and good. And if my voice gives someone else the courage to use theirs, that is exactly why I did it. I want my daughter and every young American to know one thing: You earn your place. You think for yourself. And you never let anyone put you in a box. That's the Minnesota I'm fighting for. Parents who speak up are called transphobes.Girls who lose opportunities are told to be quiet.And women's groups are nowhere to be found. This is not complicated. Girls' sports are for girls, and boys' sports are for boys. The radical Left has done everything in its power to infiltrate some of the most vulnerable minds in our society. I'll be honest with you: I never expected to wake up to the President of the United States writing about me.
On Friday afternoon, Donald Trump posted a full endorsement of Warren Davidson on Truth Social, and then spent the rest of it calling me "Reckless, Radical, and Dangerous."
Here's what that tells me. Presidents don't spend their time on races they think are safe. They weigh in when they're worried. And they're worried because this campaign is gaining ground across Butler, Warren, Preble, and Darke counties. Neighbors are talking. Volunteers are knocking doors. People are ready for a representative who shows up for them.
Now comes the part I can't do alone. When a national figure puts a target on a campaign, money and attack ads usually follow. We need to make sure every voter in OH-08 hears the truth from us, not a caricature written in Washington.

Pins for sale at a Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Dr. Abdul El-Sayed "Knock Out The Vote Tour" rally on October 31, 2026 in Mt Clemens, Michigan. Photo by Salwan Georges/Getty Images.
The balance of power in Congress is up for grabs on Tuesday. If Democrats end up taking the Senate, rural voters--through a combination of staying home and switching sides--will have played a major role. Republicans are at risk of losing Kansas, Nebraska, Iowa, Texas, Alaska, and even Florida and Mississippi. The race for the House, too, will likely come down to 21 tossup districts.
Throughout the midterms, Drop Site and Barn Raiser have been partnering for rural coverage, and below is a cheat sheet election guide to keep with you as you watch returns on Tuesday. (Breaking Points and Drop Site will be going live together starting at 6 pm ET Tuesday, so tune in there.)
This week, Drop Site's Ryan Grim and Julian Andreone sat down with Barn Raiser's Suzan Erem for a conversation on some of those rural races, which you can watch here.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/ad1db5aa-4b18-46eb-88cd-ef62f9f6a409?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Dylan Sokolovich wrote the summaries below. **[Click here](https://substack.com/redirect/e393970b-1784-40f0-ad99-c43463dbc9f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for live results on Election Day.
