name: Shawnna Bolick
subject: Why they're spending so much money here
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTE BOLICK
body:
Independent analysts say races like ours could determine control of the Legislature. Don't let outsiders decide this election.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/11J3ak8hE8L?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)
| | | | | | Good morning, patriot!I hope you all are safe and dry. Please try not to drive through flooded areas. Our washes were actively flowing with water while I was campaigning yesterday from Friday evening’s heavy rains. Many residents had to be rescued from flooded streets. If you live near Moon Valley, hopefully you can avoid driving near the East Fork of Cave Creek Wash by Seventh Avenue.Last night, we had an exuberant group of soggy trick or treaters who braved the torrential downpour to add some chocolates to their stash. We easily received over an inch and a half of rain overnight.
As our state largely remains under an active Flood Watch through tomorrow morning, our energy still remains high to finish this campaign strong.
[Out-of-state special interests have spent over $665,000](https://us.list-manage.com/hzywzQ9aSqH?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211) trying to buy this legislative seat because they know what's at stake.
They don't live here. They don't work here.Independent political observers across Arizona and our country have identified legislative races like ours as among the most competitive and consequential legislative contests in the state, if not the country. You can read about it [HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/zwX8UrydnZU?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211) and [HERE](https://us.list-manage.com/pficXQT3w7f?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211).A small number of legislative races could determine control of the Arizona Legislature, including this one.That's why out-of-state labor unions continue pouring so much money into our legislative district with their lies and misinformation.I will **NEVER** vote to repeal Arizona's Right to Work law.I believe every Arizona worker should have the freedom to decide for themselves whether to join a union. That choice belongs to YOU, not union bosses, not special interests, and certainly not labor groups based thousands of miles away.They've flooded our mailboxes and phones with lies. They've spent hundreds of thousands trying to influence this election.But they can't buy your vote.I’m asking you to flood the polls.Vote by Tuesday. Let's send a message that Arizona workers make Arizona's decisions.**Let's show them this seat is NOT for sale.**
🗳️ **Are you still holding onto an early mail ballot?**

You can no longer return your ballot by mail, as it will not arrive before Election Day. Please return your early ballot to a polling location or ballot drop box before 7pm on November 3rd. Today, you can drop your early ballot off at a designated drop box. Be sure to sign the affidavit envelope before submitting it.
If you take your early ballot directly to a polling location on Monday, you can present a valid ID to an election official who will verify your identity in person and stamp your ballot envelope "ID Verified," allowing your ballot to bypass the normal signature verification process.
If you take your early ballot directly to a polling location in Maricopa County on Tuesday, you can present a valid ID to an election official to verify your identity and then, feed your early ballot into an on-site tabulator from 6am to 7pm. To find a list of acceptable ID’s, please visit [GetID.Maricopa.Vote](https://us.list-manage.com/19Y1MYZh3DY?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211) Those who participate in this option will have their vote included in election night results.Our state’s laws require all ballots to be received by 7:00 PM on Election Day to be counted.If you haven't voted yet, I strongly encourage you to cast your ballot on or before November 3rd. [**Maricopa County Voting Locations**](https://us.list-manage.com/bZillNz3w_x?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)[**Voting Locations Outside of Maricopa County**](https://us.list-manage.com/8lxIj7wcyxA?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)
**Here’s how you can still help**
We are still meeting with District 2 voters at their doors. Last Wednesday we had a goal to reach at least 8,000 voters in our district before election day. We have almost met that goal. With your help today and tomorrow we will! Only 38.1% of all registered Republicans have turned in their ballots. We can continue to fight with your help, but we need all Republicans to vote. Please call your Republican neighbors, friends and family to remind them to vote.➡️ [Volunteer: Join Our Volunteer Team](mailto:info@bolickforarizona.com?subject=I%20want%20to%20volunteer&body=)➡️ [Donate: Support Our Final GOTV Effort](https://us.list-manage.com/u1gdKRsNJGN?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)➡️ **Vote: Encourage your friends, family, and neighbors to do the same.**
**A Truly Unexpected Honor from APSA** Honored and genuinely surprised to receive the Arizona Private School Association's “Legislator of the Year Award” on Friday. When I was asked to address their membership, I had absolutely no idea this recognition was coming, which makes it even more meaningful.

The award reflects the strong partnership between APSA, its member institutions, and policymakers who share a commitment to expanding educational opportunity and strengthening Arizona's workforce.

I'm especially proud of our collaborative work on SB 1210, which leveled the playing field for Arizona's licensed institutions while enhancing protections for students.

Thank you to APSA for this unexpected honor and for the important work you do serving more than 250,000 students through Arizona's private postsecondary education community. These students are building Arizona's future workforce.

According to data collected by the Arizona State Board for Private Postsecondary Education, Arizona is home to 238 licensed private postsecondary schools offering more than 3,242 programs. These institutions generate nearly $2.9 billion in economic activity.

Thank you, Arizona Private Schools Association. I am absolutely humbled for the recognition!
Let’s finish strong and continue fighting for our Arizona values!
Best,Shawnna

It takes years of preparation, with our door-knockers building relationships and earning trust. This is what my husband built Turning Point Action to do. Charlie wanted voting to become a habit for every America-loving patriot in this country, and our team is making that dream a reality, one front door at a time. Here's a look at what our team is doing on the ground right now: ✅ Hosting over 500 Super Chase events nationwide up until Election Day, activating people to chase votes in their own communities. ✅ Training and deploying 850+ full-time ballot chasers across key states, with the number increasing by the day. ✅ Making sure voters in key states have a plan to submit their vote, through the work of our Chase the Vote team. ✅ Working day and night at headquarters so our field teams have everything they need to identify and reach every possible voter. ✅ Calling, texting, and writing postcards to voters, and hosting community events to get out the vote. ✅ Developing the "Freedom Ticket" as a personalized voter guide for patriots to use at the voting booth in key battlegrounds. ✅ Building permanent infrastructure in the new "Red Wall" states of Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire. When I see this machine at work, I see Charlie's vision growing stronger across America.

clean_body: | | | | Patriot, Don't go to sleep on election night wishing you did more. That's the standard our Turning Point Action team is holding itself to. Right now, they're all gas, no brakes, and I couldn't be more proud of them. Charlie wanted voting to become a habit for every America-loving patriot in this country, and our team is making that dream a reality, one front door at a time. When I see this machine at work, I see Charlie's vision growing stronger across America. There's not much time left for our ballot chasers to reach every voter they can. body:
If you believe our country needs new leadership, I hope you’ll read this message.

Hi, From the start of this campaign, I have thought about why I made the decision to run for the U.S. Senate in Kansas. I’m a husband, a father of two remarkable daughters, and a grandfather. I’m also the founding pastor of the largest United Methodist Church in the United States and a proud fifth-generation Kansan. My great-great grandparents moved to Dickinson County, Kansas, 147 years ago. They were farmers and builders and good people who helped build their communities of Hope and Elmo. Like them, I love Kansas and its people, and I love my country. **That’s why I feel called to run for the U.S. Senate.** Today, our nation’s highest values and aspirations are being undermined, and chaos and corruption in Washington is tearing Americans apart. We’ve insulted and alienated our allies. And we have a government in DC that’s making life harder for Kansans. People can’t afford the basics – food, gas and health care. **[I’m running for the United States Senate because I care about our country, because things need to change, and because I know I can build bridges, bring people together to solve problems, and be a champion for Kansas. Can you chip in to my campaign and Sharice Davids before the election in just two days?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142691105/657717583/1711583426?refcode=email_110126_hamilton&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMmI3YTk0YS0xZGQ2LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8rukwEWSzJZo7vsWJbGZfzfbKLd0T_HSS5Eii91iYmE=)** I’ve heard from Kansans all over the state who voted for Roger Marshall six years ago and now feel he’s not listening to them. The deadline is fast approaching -- and our baby girl is leading the charge [to make a difference](https://substack.com/redirect/9a02d87b-6079-4991-bc10-91c3b98276e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the lives of children.
She is an elite athlete -- training six days a week. She takes honors and AP classes and has worked hard to maintain her 4.43 GPA. She's disciplined, kind, and focused -- the kind of young woman who believes hard work and heart can change the world.
Now, she wants to help other children who are struggling at this time in their lives.
Click [here](https://substack.com/redirect/9a02d87b-6079-4991-bc10-91c3b98276e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to help her help others.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9a02d87b-6079-4991-bc10-91c3b98276e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Hear from Kayla yourself...
###### **Hello Friends and Family!**
I am honored to serve as the Mini-THON Captain for the Games and Rules Committee, where I get to combine my love for bringing people together with a cause that means so much to me: helping kids conquer childhood cancer through [Four Diamonds Mini-THON](https://substack.com/redirect/9a02d87b-6079-4991-bc10-91c3b98276e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
What I love most about Mini-THON is seeing how something as simple as coming together as a community can make such a lasting difference in a child's life. My school and every committee work tirelessly throughout the year, dedicating countless hours to fundraising, planning, and creating an unforgettable night for our students and Four Diamonds families. Together, we have raised over **$2 MILLION** in the past 20 years, and I am so proud to be part of a tradition that continues to grow.
Every dollar I help raise supports Four Diamonds' life-saving research to better prevent, diagnose, treat, and ultimately cure childhood cancer. Beyond research, I am proud to help ensure that every Four Diamonds child, regardless of their family's income, receives the highest quality childhood cancer care without ever having to see a bill for that care.
Since 1972, Four Diamonds has supported more than 4,800 children and their families. Being able to play even a small role in that mission is something I truly value. Mini-THON has shown me that making a difference does not always require doing something extraordinary--it can start with simply showing up, caring deeply, and bringing others together for a cause bigger than yourself.
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/9a02d87b-6079-4991-bc10-91c3b98276e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Abbott’s numbers
body:
Abbott has spent a total of $281 million this year.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, Greg Abbott’s final campaign finance report before Election Day recently came out.
In just the last month, Abbott spent $35.8 million, **more than $1 million a day** , mostly on TV ads. That’s nearly as much as our campaign has spent in the entire year since I launched this race.
Over this entire year, Abbott has spent a total of $281 million to our $36.8 million.
**He’s outspending us nearly 8:1, and he’s already spent more than double what he spent in his entire last campaign.**
Think about that for a second. You don’t spend $1 million a day unless you’re worried about losing.
We have a real shot at winning — I feel it in my bones, but I’m going to need your support in these final days to win. **[Will you chip in $5 right now to help power this campaign in these last two days?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261101_2_abbott.KdpVM5&refcode=em20261101-2617&amount=5&t=2&akid=2617%2E299639%2EXcCzGV)**
Seven polls in the last month have shown Abbott behind, something that has _never_ happened in any of his four campaigns for governor. Honestly, that doesn’t surprise me. Everywhere I go, Texans from all walks of life tell me they’re fed up. They’re tired of Abbott promising to fix the very problems he’s spent the last 12 years creating.
And if you want to know why, just follow the money.
Nearly one-fifth of Abbott’s latest donations came from one man: Elon Musk. Billionaire Kenneth Fisher gave $2 million. Casino magnate Miriam Adelson gave $500,000. Data center developer Harlan Crow gave another $250,000. These are the people Greg Abbott really works for, and it’s why he cuts backroom deals with executives without a second thought for the people who actually live here.
We’ve never needed to match Abbott dollar for dollar, and we never will. He’s outspent us from day one, and **this is still the closest governor’s race in the nation.** We just need enough to reach the voters who are going to decide this election.
**[So, Peter, will you rush in $5 today to make sure we continue to have the funds to compete in these final days?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261101_2_abbott.KdpVM5&refcode=em20261101-2617&amount=5&t=3&akid=2617%2E299639%2EXcCzGV)**

Thank you,
Gina

My team was going through our supporter records and took particular notice of yours – because it showed that YOU are one of my most attentive grassroots supporters. You’ve been getting these emails for a while now, and we see you're keeping up with the latest on this election. I want you to know that _I know_ how engaged you’ve been with our campaign and how much I appreciate it.
**Today, I’m asking you to take the next step by** [**_making your first donation of $5_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1764&amount=5&t=9&akid=5255%2E124072%2ECt3urq)**– here’s why:**

2\. Far-right super PACs – including a Trump-aligned group – have spent tens of millions to defeat me and prop up my Republican opponent, Michael Whatley.
3\. Their attacks are working: Our momentum is slipping. **That’s why Trump came _back_ to North Carolina to double down on these attacks, and why a GOP super PAC is launching _another_ million-dollar attack ad buy.**

Since I sent you the note below on October 1, I've met with voters every day from Wilberforce to Lima to Pickaway to Youngstown.
Not all of you have been able to come out to a campaign stop, so I want you to know:
In cities, suburbs, small towns, and farm country: Ohioans are showing up. People are ready for change.
Our message is resonating because we're telling the truth.
**But the reason we 've been able to get that message out to every part of the state is because of **_**you**_**.** The other side is relying on billionaires who think of our state as something they fly over, and who have no idea what it's like to actually work for a living. They're spending ungodly sums of money and they expect a return on that investment.

We're building our campaign differently. More than 400,000 people like you have made a donation to this campaign and our average online donation is just $39.24 this past month. I'm really damn proud of that.
If we win in two days, it will be because we built this the right way. It'll be because grassroots supporters like you helped us go toe to toe with some of the wealthiest people in the world. So I have to ask you one more time: can you help me run through the tape to Election Night? **[Chip in](https://substack.com/redirect/e4b4ce89-1981-4542-b854-eed31aad6333?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to support our grassroots efforts and field team in the final stretch. Or sign up to **[volunteer](https://substack.com/redirect/1ceb677d-e923-4f64-b2f7-a6fbc84be020?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , which you can do from wherever you're reading this.
Thank you for believing in me and the people of Ohio. Now let's win this.
\- Sherrod
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e4b4ce89-1981-4542-b854-eed31aad6333?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
With the election just days away, I'm leaving the house early every morning to hit the campaign trail. Before I go, I say goodbye to Connie if she isn't campaigning with me that day (she's great on the trail), I give Franklin and Walter a scratch behind the ears (they're not as good on the trail), and I stop at the door to read a small note Connie and I have come to appreciate more than we ever anticipated:
_**" GO FIND THE JOY!"**_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e4b4ce89-1981-4542-b854-eed31aad6333?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Go find the joy... it's easy on some days. But to tell you the truth, there are some days when it's a challenge. It can be a challenge to find joy when I travel the state and hear from family after family who are struggling to afford gas and groceries right now. It's a challenge when some of the wealthiest, most powerful people on the planet are spending millions of dollars to lie about me on every TV in the state. It's even a challenge to be away from Connie and the dogs so often. But somehow, despite those challenges, when I look for joy, I can always find it.
I know you might be facing challenges of your own - worries about the economy, fears about the future, or just the everyday things that can make life tough. So, I'd like to lend you a little joy I've found on the campaign trail lately.
I found joy on the long drive from Columbus to Steubenville, a blue-collar town on the Ohio River on the eastern edge of the state. We drove along the winding river. The trees were lush and green, it had just rained, and the air smelled new. That bit of joy, simply paying attention to this beautiful state, made me even more grateful to meet with an overflowing room of supporters at a local IBEW hall. It isn't always easy to live on the outer edge of the state, but the folks I met had such pride in their town and such determination to build its future. I found joy in their resolve that day.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e4b4ce89-1981-4542-b854-eed31aad6333?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I found joy on another rainy day, this time in Cincinnati, meeting with students at a tailgate on campus before a Bearcats football game. As we ran from tent to tent to stay as dry as possible (not very successfully), I was reminded of one of the many reasons I'm in this fight: for the young people across this state whose audacious dreams should come before the billionaires and corporations rigging the system. I'm in this fight and out on the trail, rain or shine, because young people deserve a senator who fights for their future. I found joy in their enthusiasm that day.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e4b4ce89-1981-4542-b854-eed31aad6333?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I found joy when 500 supporters gathered in Cleveland to welcome Connie and me to the city for a big rally. I looked around the room and saw hundreds of hopeful faces, each one showing up on a Wednesday night because they are mad about the direction Jon Husted has dragged this country, they're mad the cost to fill their gas tank has doubled, they're mad Washington keeps giving billionaires tax cuts while their health premiums double or triple. But they weren't just mad, they were eager. Eager because they know Election Day is just around the corner and they're ready to hold Washington accountable. Eager to unrig the system and build a better future for their loved ones. Eager to knock doors and make calls and make sure we win this fight. They know it takes all of us, and they showed up because they're ready to put in the work. I found joy in their passion that night.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e4b4ce89-1981-4542-b854-eed31aad6333?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It may be challenging, but finding joy every day on the campaign trail makes me more resolved than ever to finish this fight and win this race. But I can't do it alone - that's why I'm grateful for you, and hopeful that, if you look for it, you can find the joy in this journey as well.
Thank you for being in this fight with me. Together, with some grit, determination, and a whole lot of work, we're going to win this fight. And we're going to do it joyfully.

body:
| | | Peter, This year, our slate of WFP champions took on brutal far-right lies, massive dark money attacks, and opponents who insisted that the status quo was the best we’ll ever do. And despite the odds, across the country, _they won._ **Now, with just two days until this election is over, we’re on the verge of sending the largest ever bloc of WFP champions to Washington.** **[Can you pitch in $10 to our General Election Fund today to help take back the House, stand up to the far right, and build a powerful coalition for working families in Congress?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9igmXNrMmcHBw0sn-I3CYyUpzp6dVttrGG6HDqPd2aNghA5dil1eYA69MsRf7oMaWevc4Js2NvvSL5cmtAPcEmrF09MUX3qgpO8-KLm4yEZ_yA7jayzhXMO4XLtq-4ai2c_1p7eZvAogzGZDyd0spcdW3N5_F7CVIO74UDsbP6wM6HA5tdVl0VpSGACO6Il_LTKaFAHHJLOfMqsJuf73vKB3Y5G7r0oER8536_bpJ3RvdSpOdnmxM1EqPG95TP6ox7Zjgl0m5EbF2Ac66jzMYnF4iOgnChDaXfUS6_JdODtdBk_Kz5lA_YGeTXvY7MECy1S7_U3No98xnAphhFU2R8J0z6-XEE0vLx6Cumno9ofWQbNWJSX9NgITZ4GEleDUAJdIEp5LabPNACLmh8bJMKSNrPxfSyJstn-GjQUt4LTM/4vd/_RNthMpCQ0S5C6smbt-ZOg/h0/h001.AXeOnoTPePmBIgOHJE6aQOCfkDO4QG0cO9OAP2zHMNI)** **[Donate $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9igmXNrMmcHBw0sn-I3CYyUpzp6dVttrGG6HDqPd2aNg8ioR6R20vjC9tgXRrbAvc7So5S2lR5XZlUJ1eauUQJ8w8KoVZvligpf4SB3yC5BaXlApsviWmzFspntJUb4YRWYcWTLGseN8BwduwI40K9sEidIVKX2RDaZp4u7Wdw4cmHRyX_u-5qDJePOnGeJNSVzbFoC23WUGrIEMGnAeKgg2nlfYgqZrnIZIs94ctv4U1lieoQ3S1szqAlIp8-z9E9i8yWr_tmLHqCWQmSexUR-zaTNMKrArQgsBZ8qU8Mi2S58Vcv9VDrF1g3e0OTTZ9NSxAVvx8t2uEGMdCERWpIm5-ZhJ00QwaDTTa8qHAAITHQNwtWTY7qYbtseZSq8GcG0oZ4iQGmb_MGev4hFdn_wuSwZIphzvsGVaq8k89OCY/4vd/_RNthMpCQ0S5C6smbt-ZOg/h1/h001.nhxTngZMDHlsE4XG61eQZZebO1lmjzvBepTazyQ7-Eg)** Peter, there are a lot of things that our WFP congressional champions don’t have in common:
1. **They come to public service from all different backgrounds.** Bob Brooks (PA-07) served his community as a firefighter, Abdul El-Sayed (MI-Sen) is a trained physician who saved the Detroit Health Department after bankruptcy, Brian Poindexter (OH-07) helped build Cleveland as a union ironworker, Randy Villegas (CA-22) served as an educator, and Angie Nixon (FL-Sen) opened her own independent bookstore. Our champions understand the struggles that working families face — because they’ve lived them firsthand.
2. **They’re running all over the country,** from all the way up north with Troy Jackson (ME-Sen) to down south to Angie Nixon and Justin J. Pearson (TN-09), from East Coaster Brad Lander (NY-10) to West Coasters Aisha Wahab (CA-14) and Mai Vang (CA-07), and throughout the Heartland with Will Lawrence (MI-07), Bob Brooks, and Charles Booker (KY-Sen). Our nationwide movement is fighting _everywhere,_ for all of our communities.
3. **And they’re facing off against different shades of MAGA extremism.** Will Lawrence has been boldly taking on Big Tech and AI in his race, while his opponent has taken over $1 million from data center and AI developers. Abdul El-Sayed is facing $12.7 million in new spending from AIPAC after successfully beating their $30 million in his primary earlier this year. Brian Poindexter is running against one of Trump’s favorite aides, an extremist with a history of violence. clean_body: | Hey Friend, It's Jerri Green. When we started this campaign, the political class laughed us off. They told us a grassroots movement rooted in everyday folks couldn't take on Marsha's multi-million dollar machine and elect a democrat in deep-red Tennessee. They looked at our gerrymandered state map, shook their heads, and wrote us off before we even laced up our boots. They never thought we could do this. But I believed in you anyway. I knew Tennesseans were built for a fight against the odds. We’ve seen that fighting spirit everyday of this race, as we’ve packed over 250 town halls across the state. We’ve felt it as the sheer determination of Tennesseans who are through with being ignored by politicians in Nashville has reached a fever pitch. Now, look at the board. Early voting numbers are blowing past the pundit’s expectations all across the state, and the establishment figureheads like Marsha Blackburn are panicking because they now realize the s trength of the movement we have built, made up entirely of everyday working people. We’ve come this far on faith, grit, and plain old-fashioned hard work. But this final stretch is where the toughest battles are fought and won, and the opposition is pouring millions into a last-minute desperate smear campaign in an attempt to drown us out. We cannot slow down now. If you believe in what we’re building, if you believe that Tennessee can be more than another foregone conclusion, I need you to have faith in us, like we have faith in you, and stand with us one more time in these final few days. 👉We have $50k left to raise to fully cover our GOTV organizing ** = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Let's prove every single doubter wrong. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Are you tired of hearing about Democratic candidates selling out for
corporate money? So-called leaders who refuse to stand up for progressive
values? Well, we have the perfect candidate for you...

It’s Angela Gonzales-Torres in California’s 34th Congressional District.
She’s a working-class champion locked in a close race against a Do-Nothing
Democratic incumbent, and she needs our help to win. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261101-2-agt.Ub3z1A&refcode=em20261101-38407&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1002&akid=38407%2E1203867%2EBDZ3VC ]Can you split
$10 between her campaign and Justice Democrats to help put
her over the top on Tuesday?

We endorsed Angela because she has lived the struggles her community faces
daily and will fight those crises with the urgency that her constituents
deserve. With her in Congress, we will have another champion for Medicare
for All, ending the genocide in Gaza, rejecting corporate PAC money, and
making sure working-class Angelenos have a true fighter for them in
Congress.

If she wins, she will take her district back from the claws of the real
estate lobby pricing out her neighbors while paying corporate stooges like
Jimmy Gomez to look the other way. He’s in the pocket of AIPAC, AI, and
Wall Street, and under investigation for sexual misconduct — and Angela
has a better shot at unseating him than any of his previous challengers.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261101-2-agt.Ub3z1A&refcode=em20261101-38407&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=38407%2E1203867%2EBDZ3VC ]Tweet by Alexei Koseff: Progressives have tried for five elections to
oust Jimmy Gomez. With the congressman now under investigation for sexual
misconduct, his challenger has a better shot than ever before — if she can
spread the word in this low-turnout district.

But Jimmy won’t make this easy. He’s urging super PACs to spend against
her in the final days of this race with a ridiculous message: attacking
Angela for reaching out to voters by joining a Twitch livestream.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261101-2-agt.Ub3z1A&refcode=em20261101-38407&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=38407%2E1203867%2EBDZ3VC ]Tweet by Ryan Grim: Democrat Jimmy Gomez is now urging his super PAC to
run ads aimed at Republicans and Democrats over 40 blasting his also-Dem
opponent for going on Hasan Piker’s stream...

Establishment Democrats like Jimmy are desperate. They know regular people
are demanding change and rallying behind Angela, so he’s begging big money
to come in and save him. But we know organized people can beat organized
money if enough of us stand up to fight.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261101-2-agt.Ub3z1A&refcode=em20261101-38407&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1005&akid=38407%2E1203867%2EBDZ3VC ]The big wins we’ve secured this year have been because of people power,
and we can secure another victory in CA-34 with your help. Split a
donation of $10 between Angela’s campaign and Justice
Democrats to help her win on Tuesday!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20261101-2-agt.Ub3z1A&refcode=em20261101-38407&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=10&t=1024&akid=38407%2E1203867%2EBDZ3VC ]Contribute $10

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

subject: Thank you, Peter

body:
I wanted to write you personally to say thank you.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20261101-6919-footer&t=1&akid=6919%2E420207%2EVIWmW7)
Hi Peter,
**I wanted to write you personally to say:_Thank you._**
When we set our October end-of-month goal, I knew it was ambitious. We don’t have corporate PACs or billionaires on speed dial funding the work we’re doing. We just have you.
But this grassroots movement came through. Working people here in Seattle and across the country pitched in $5, $15, $25 at a time. Together, we hit our goal. That’s what a people-powered movement looks like, and I’m grateful to have you by my side.
**Now, with just 2 days left until Election Day, we’re putting every cent to work.**
That means volunteers knocking on doors, texting voters, making calls, and reminding our neighbors to get their ballots in before the deadline. And we have the potential to make a real difference on Tuesday.
So thank you again, Peter. And here’s the last thing I’ll ask of you today: [**make sure you have a plan to vote**](http://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/55518?t=2&akid=6919%2E420207%2EVIWmW7), and make sure your friends and family vote, too.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

We’ve made it to November. Election Day is less than 48 hours away. And I have an important message for the Republican Party:**Don’t mistake Minnesota nice for Minnesota**** _weak_****.** I have always been incredibly proud to be a born-and-raised, sixth-generation Minnesotan. Our state is full of beautiful lakes. We have legendary sports teams. | | | I know you’ve heard a lot from my team and me recently, so please forgive me. Sending this email to you is the last thing I want to do, but I have to.We’re falling short of our daily fundraising goal, so I need you to split a donation between my campaign and Equal Opportunity Now right now to help us get back on track. Our campaign has been mounting a full court press for months. We went up on TV with ads early to spread our message. We also invested heavily in our field program to start having meaningful conversations with voters as soon as we could. In a race this important, with the stakes so high, we aren’t letting a moment go to waste. But this also means that we’re spending through a significant amount of resources. We’ve even overshot our budget in some places to make sure we’re reaching and persuading the Ohioans who will decide this election. Folks are clearly resonating with our message, but crypto's most powerful super PAC is flooding Ohio with another dark money cash infusion to run vicious attack ads that lie about me and my record. This will turn the tides against us, unless we can raise more money and reach more people – quickly. Peter Ohtaki — October 26, 2026

**NO Measure RTM** \- Highest sales taxes already, [adjust to post-pandemic ridership with WFH](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6ae78c5603f26715d351ac1e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fblog%2Fregional-transit-tax-measure-rtm-locks-in-14-years-of-funding-for-system-built-for-a-world-thats-gone%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D6ae6ebd8faa5f1638b05808b%26ss_email_id%3D6ae78c5603f26715d351ac1e%26ss_campaign_name%3DEnough%2Bis%2BEnough%253A%2BCommon%2BSense%2BGuide%2Bto%2BTax%2BPropositions%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-11-01T19%253A00%253A50Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6ae6ebd8faa5f1638b05808b&l=en-US&s=3bvEBbKd0ztOMHDDaxfZ_V73foI%3D), $5B on balance sheets **NO Prop 3** \- Sacramento promised in 2012 that high-earner income tax surcharge would be temporary. **NO Prop 40** \- Billionaire tax can be amended by Sacramento without voter approval **YES Prop 41** \- Holds Sacramento accountable for results **YES Prop 42** \- No tax on retirement plans (backstop if Prop 40 passes) **YES Prop 43** \- Close loophole allowing local districts to pass taxes like RTM with simple majority vote **STEVE HILTON for Governor** \- No tax on <$150k income, $3.00/gal gas by suspending CA gas and cap/trade taxes. **MICHAEL GATES for Attorney General** \- Fighting Sacramento’s power grab from cities of local control over land use

Team, When you look at the numbers, the path forward is clear: **The fight for Arizona's future comes down to a handful of legislative seats.** In competitive districts across our state, dynamic leaders are stepping up to fight for us:
* **In LD2,** Dr. Amelia Gallitano is running for Senate to reform the voucher system and protect access to quality healthcare.
* **In LD4,** Aaron Lieberman is running to restore funding to public education, while Karen Gresham and Tammy Caputi fight for real economic accountability in the House.
* **In LD13,** educator Rockee Armstrong and combat veteran Jacob Weinberg are running to invest in our schools, protect our local water supply, and lower costs.
* **In LD17,** Rep. Kevin Volk and retired Air Force Col. Holly Lyon are leading the charge to keep housing affordable and protect our water future.

Campaigning in Texas is like campaigning for a country. Texas is a big state with**more counties than any other state in America.**
With **254 counties,** from the Panhandle to the Rio Grande Valley, East Texas to El Paso, every community has its own story, its own challenges, and its own vision for the future.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/31fa4c92-aac6-48dd-a9ac-7dfab282a11b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
But too many Texans have been left behind by Greg Abbott's leadership.
**[We've got more to say, but first: can you pitch in $2.54, a penny for each of the 254 counties Abbott has failed?](https://substack.com/redirect/31fa4c92-aac6-48dd-a9ac-7dfab282a11b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE $2.54 ->](https://substack.com/redirect/31fa4c92-aac6-48dd-a9ac-7dfab282a11b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Gina has traveled thousands of miles across Texas, sitting down with voters, listening to their concerns, and hearing what they need from their next governor.
She's met teachers worried about the future of public education. Families struggling with rising costs. Small business owners trying to keep their doors open. Rural communities fighting to have a say in decisions that affect their land, their resources, and their way of life.
Everywhere she goes, Gina hears the same message: **Texans are ready for leadership that actually shows up.** And Greg Abbott couldn't even show up to debate Gina at least once before Tuesday's election.
He has spent years prioritizing billionaire donors, corporate interests, and political insiders. This campaign is about something different: a Texas where every community has a voice and every family has a chance to thrive.
That's why we've been committed to building this campaign the grassroots way: one conversation, one supporter, and one county at a time.
**[Election Day is just two days away, and Texans in all 254 counties are already casting their ballots. Will you pitch in $2.54 to help us reach voters in every corner of Texas and elect a governor who will finally show up and get the job done?](https://substack.com/redirect/31fa4c92-aac6-48dd-a9ac-7dfab282a11b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ DONATE ->](https://substack.com/redirect/31fa4c92-aac6-48dd-a9ac-7dfab282a11b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you,
Team Gina

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/25013?t=1001&akid=2131%2E181023%2ERfkw49 ][IMG]

Hi, it’s
Jocelyn Benson.

With just 2 days to go until Election Day and shady GOP super PACs
spending millions on attack ads, I know you’ve probably heard a lot about
me and this race.

Today, I don’t want to talk about the attack ads or my Trump-endorsed
opponent. Instead, I want to give you a chance to hear about why I’m
running, directly from me. [ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/25013?t=1002&akid=2131%2E181023%2ERfkw49 ]When I’m done, anything you can pitch in
will go miles in helping us secure our victory here in Michigan.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/25013?t=1003&akid=2131%2E181023%2ERfkw49 ]Pitch in →

I’ve dedicated my entire career to one principle: that everyone deserves a
fair shot at life.

It’s why I started my career investigating threats to democracy and civil
rights in the U.S. and abroad.

It’s why I became a law clerk in Detroit, fighting to protect and defend
people’s civil rights and freedoms.

It’s why, as Dean of Wayne State University Law School, I worked to ensure
all students could afford their education by freezing tuition and
expanding scholarships.

And it’s why, as Secretary of State, I’ve fought to make everyday life
easier for all Michiganders, secure our elections, and expand voter
access.

But our work is far from finished. That’s why I’m running for Governor. To
make sure Michigan is a place where everyone — from our kids to our
seniors — can stay, grow up, and thrive.

Here’s the deal: this is one of the most competitive gubernatorial races
in the country — and with megadonors like the DeVos family and Elon Musk
pouring millions into Michigan, I can’t win this race unless I have your
support.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/25013?t=1004&akid=2131%2E181023%2ERfkw49 ]So please, if you believe in our mission of creating a better, more
affordable, and more accessible Michigan, will you chip in whatever you
can today?

That’s not my opinion. That’s what a state grand jury found. The money came from a Medicaid settlement over a company overbilling a program that provides health insurance to poor children. Instead of going back to Florida taxpayers, $10 million was diverted to Hope Florida and ultimately millions flowed into political committees and the Republican Party of Florida. And the grand jury found that Ashley Moody knew about the plan and authorized her deputy to sign the settlement. I’m running to defeat Ashley Moody because Floridians deserve a Senator who fights for working families not another rubber stamp for Ron DeSantis and his corrupt political machine. DeSantis appointed Moody to this Senate seat because he knows she’ll stand with him. I’m running to make sure this seat belongs to the people of Florida instead. We can beat her, but we need the resources to expose this corruption across Florida and build the movement to flip this seat blue. At 5:30 pm ET, Maryland Governor Wes Moore is hosting The Collective PAC's final fundraiser and get-out-the-vote call of the 2026 cycle. We are bringing our endorsed Black candidates for Governor and U.S. Senate onto one screen, one after another, to tell you where their races stand and what they need from us before Tuesday.
This is not a ticketed event. There is no cost to join. We want 5,000 of you on this call, because the candidates deserve to see the size of the community standing behind them.
**RSVP and join tonight:[https://collectivepac.org/timeisnow](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a3c5f6a3-6d1e-487a-a555-68e4b07fea12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Sunday, November 1, 5:30 to 6:30 pm ET
**Why this call matters**
Ten years ago we started The Collective PAC because Black candidates were being told to wait their turn. This cycle, eleven of them are on the ballot for the highest offices in their states. Several are in races that will be decided by a point or two. The money raised in the final 48 hours goes straight into turnout: doors, calls, rides to the polls, and the last round of ads before voters make up their minds.
Tonight's call is where that money comes from. It comes from us.
**What we are asking**
Give what you can before the call starts, so the candidates can hear the number live: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2026sen-gov](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/90db1d4b-d0a2-4c57-9fc8-8fc125a27025?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
$26 is the floor. It is a nod to the year, and it is the amount that gets 5,000 people to a real number fast. If you can do $100, $250, or more, every gift splits across our endorsed Senate and gubernatorial candidates, so one contribution reaches every race on the ballot.
Then show up at 5:30. Bring someone with you. Forward this to the group chat, post the link, text the three people you have been meaning to text.
**After tonight**
Go vote on Tuesday if you have not already. If you need a ride, we have you covered through our Rides To Vote program. Reply to this message and we will get you the details.
We have spent ten years building toward moments like this one. The candidates have done their part. Governor Moore is doing his. Tonight is ours.
See you at 5:30.
Quentin James
Founder and President, The Collective PAC
P.S. If you cannot make the call live, give now and we will send you the recording. The money has to be in the bank by Tuesday morning to matter.

One of the best parts of being on the campaign trail is the friends you make along the way.
Luckily for me, some of those friends are also my biggest inspirations. It's been the honor of a lifetime to receive their endorsements.
_President Barack Obama._
_Governor Andy Beshear._
_Governor JB Pritzker._
_Governor Wes Moore._
_Senator Elizabeth Warren._
_Senator Raphael Warnock._
_Senator Mark Kelly._
_Senator Michael Bennet._
Their faith in my campaign solidifies what I already know: I have what it takes to replace Mitch McConnell and redefine the status quo here in Kentucky.
Your grassroots support is the last thing I need to carry this campaign to the finish line. Will you co-endorse me with a donation as small as $1 so I can capitalize on this momentum and defeat Andy Barr?
[Chip in to my Senate Campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/527a76a5-d116-40c3-aa6a-04c74b9568a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Together, we are undefeatable.

_**Charles Booker**_

In the House, Democrats win at least 250 seats.
In the Senate, Democrats win 55.
In the states, Democrats hold 29 of the nation's 50 governorships.
Those numbers sit above what the professionals will tell you, and I know it. The Cook Political Report's final House projection gives Democrats 227 to 240 seats. Cook has Democrats netting 2 to 6 Senate seats, which tops out at 53. Nate Silver's model puts Democrats' chances of taking the House at about 95%, with an average gain of 25 seats. I've read all of it. I'm going past it on purpose.
In the Senate, 55 means holding Michigan, Georgia, New Hampshire, and Minnesota, then flipping North Carolina, Maine, Ohio, Texas, Iowa, Kansas, Alaska, and South Carolina. In the governors' races, 29 means holding Kansas, Wisconsin, Michigan, and Arizona while flipping Iowa, Georgia, Ohio, Nevada, and Nebraska. That would give Democrats a majority of governors for the first time in 16 years, with 3 to spare.
## Why I'm Not Crazy
Start with the national number. Marist's late-October poll for NPR and PBS News has Democrats ahead on the generic ballot among likely voters, 52% to 44%. The same poll puts Donald Trump's approval at 40%, with 59% disapproving. A president 19 points underwater doesn't get a soft landing in a midterm. He gets 2018 again, with interest.

In the latest public polls of the 7 races Cook rates as toss-ups, the Democrat leads every one: Mary Peltola by 7 in Alaska, Josh Turek by 3 in Iowa, Adam Hamilton by 4 in Kansas, Troy Jackson by 4 in Maine, Abdul El-Sayed by 7 in Michigan, Sherrod Brown by 4 in Ohio, and James Talarico by 6 in Texas. body:
Are you with me, Peter?
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1927&source=&t=1&akid=5261%2E124072%2ENc4Lfc) | | | |

Peter, I’ve never lost an election – and **I don’t plan to break my streak now.**
I’m ready to bring this thing home and flip North Carolina’s U.S. Senate seat blue, but I need your support until the very end. [**_Your first donation of $5 to my campaign today would mean a lot to me. In a race with this much at stake, every dollar could be the difference between winning and losing._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1927&amount=5&t=8&akid=5261%2E124072%2ENc4Lfc)
The GOP has been after me from the start. They know as well as we do that if we lose in North Carolina, Democrats will lose our shot at taking back the Senate.
Now, their attacks are reaching a fever pitch – with President Trump and Vice President Vance _returning_ to North Carolina these past couple of weeks to rally for my opponent, Michael Whatley. Trump and the GOP are calling me names, distorting my record and spreading lies about who I am and what I’m fighting for.
Look, Peter, I’ve been straightforward with you about this campaign from the start: our plans, where we stand in the polls, what we expect to come and what we need from you.
By the latest tally, Republican super PACs have poured tens of millions into this race. Polling shows our lead growing – but this is North Carolina, and we can’t leave anything to chance. **Most urgently, we’re running short of the resources we need to reach more voters before they head to the polls.**
[**_That’s why I’m asking you to contribute $5 for the first time today to help me reach my $1 million goal before Election Day. We can win this race, but only if we stick together. So please, Peter, will you chip in?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1927&amount=5&t=9&akid=5261%2E124072%2ENc4Lfc)

Friend, I was in a crowded coffee shop in Topeka a few weeks ago listening to Kansans talk about their challenges, dreams and hopes for the future.

While I was there, I shared the most fundamental message of my campaign: **Remember to be a good neighbor.** You don’t have to agree with someone to love them. In fact, our system works best when we disagree, because then we can find a compromise that addresses the concerns of both sides.
**I know this may not be a typical approach to politics, but the _only_ way to solve the problems our country is facing is to find a way to work together — even when we disagree. **[**_If you’re with me, will you chip in now to help me show Kansans that there’s a better way forward before they head to the polls? Friend, I’m not a career politician. In Washington, I’ll fight against the chaos and division, but that starts right here in Kansas. I always tell my supporters, “If you are going to have my sign in your yard, you need to be a good neighbor. _And_ if someone on your street has a Roger Marshall sign up, be kind to them, too. Say, ‘Hey, I know we disagree, but that’s OK. I love you as my neighbor just the same.’"

I know there are a lot of problems that are making life harder right now. Cuts to healthcare, skyrocketing gas prices, out-of-control grocery costs ... the list goes on and on.

**When I’m elected, I’ll fight to fix those problems for every single person, regardless of whether they voted for me or Roger Marshall. But nothing we do to fix what’s broken will matter if we can’t be good neighbors. If we can’t find a way to love each other through our differences. If we can’t respect that we all have different beliefs and work to reach compromises and find common ground.**

So be a good neighbor, friend. Get out to the polls and make your voice heard, but remember to love your neighbor, too, no matter what.
[**With the election 2 days away, I need a surge of grassroots support from people like you to help me reach more Kansans, get out the vote and retire Roger Marshall. ## Regional Transit Tax Measure (RTM) locks in 14 years of funding for system built for a world that's gone - NO on RTM
---
Bill Jackson, Frontier Republicans & Friends — October 23, 2026
---
The pandemic shock was real, and it wasn't transit agencies' fault. But their response is to preserve a cost and compensation structure built for the old ridership level rather than adapt it- and voters are being asked to bail out that choice for the next fourteen years, no matter what happens to costs, ridership, or how the Bay Area gets around. Taxpayer subsidies per Bay Area transit trip have grown 2.75x in ten years — from $3.53 to $9.69 — even as ridership across BART, Muni, AC Transit, Caltrain, and VTA remains down 37% from 2019. This November's Regional Transit Measure locks in that same cost structure for 14 more years, no reforms required. [https://nonewtransittax.com/](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6ae798d94aab1455ef247000&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnonewtransittax.com%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6ae6eb76b161f75289605305&l=en-US&s=1ytGFwOKeYBy98_585FPXnKWH7w%3D)
---
|
---
#### **Reject the Transit Tax this November -and soften the landing.**
If the tax fails, BART's own board-approved contingency plan calls for closing 15 stations; Caltrain's calls for ending service after 9 p.m. and closing a third of its stations. Those cuts would hit hardest the roughly one in four Bay Area adults who ride transit weekly. That pain can be reduced without locking in 14 years of new taxes: the state could redirect a portion of the _**$1 billion in cap-and-invest funds**_ now earmarked for high-speed rail and free up billions more by pausing megaprojects sized for pre-pandemic ridership, like BART's Silicon Valley Phase Il extension.
#### **Develop a new regional transit plan based on post-pandemic reality**
Most office workers _**work from home (WFH)**_ at least one day a week, usually Fridays. We need a new plan for Bay Area transit sized for today's ridership, not pre-pandemic assumptions. It should require binding cost and compensation reforms, tie service levels to real ridership, and set concrete benchmarks for cost-saving technology - automated trains, on-demand shuttles, predictive maintenance. And it should move fast: transit plans typically take years and rest on utopian assumptions that never pan out. A tight, one-year deadline would force realistic choices instead.
#### **Return to voters in 2028 with a smaller, smarter measure**
Maintaining Bay Area transit will take more money than agencies currently have. But voters should be asked for modest, targeted funds - paired with real cost reductions (automated trains, fewer massive capital projects) sized to today's ridership, not yesterday's. The priority: protect bus service for the low-income residents who depend on transit most.
#### **Imagining the Bay Area Transit System of 2050**
---
|
---
#### It's 2050 - A rider in Fremont steps outside, and within ninety seconds a shared, autonomous shuttle glides up, dispatched the instant she opened the app, not on a fixed 20-minute schedule. The shuttle links her to a driverless high-frequency rail trunk line. She pays once for this trip, and the operators get paid a little extra because her trip was fast and reliable.

clean_body: | | | | = | | | Peter, I recently sat down with The Advocate to talk about the history we are about to make: sending the first openly gay member of Congress from Michigan to Washington. | | | = | | I also told them that part of my radical gay agenda includes fixing the roads because gay people drive on them too. 😉 In all seriousness, we must show up in the rooms where decisions about us are being made. Republicans are resorting to bigotry and painting vulnerable people as threats for their own political gain. The last time I checked, no trans athlete in Michigan is making gas prices spike. 🙄 We need to stay focused on taking back the House so we can finally pass the Equality Act and enact federal LGBTQ+ nondiscrimination protections. To get there, we need a stronger, bolder, tougher Democratic Party – one that does not show up to a knife fight carrying a pie chart. That is the change I am going to bring to Washington. = | | | | | = | | | = | | | = | | | = | | | | = | | Let’s do this, Jeremy Moss | | | | | | = | | | | | | Paid for by Jeremy Moss for Congress | | Jeremy Moss for Congress 2211 S Telegraph Rd PO Box 7023 Bloomfield Hills, MI 48302 United States | | | | | | | | | | = | | | = | | This message was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. | |

body:
We turned a long shot into a dead heat. Now we need to finish it. | | | | I wanted you to hear this from me first.

**A brand-new poll shows me leading Greg Abbott, 49% to 46%.** Here’s why that number matters so much. In early October, we had cut Abbott’s lead to just 1.3 points. Then the polls started moving back his way. His lead in the polling average grew, and a lot of insiders decided this race was slipping away from us.

This poll was taken in the middle of early voting, and it shows us ahead. What makes it remarkable is this: **Greg Abbott has now spent $181 million in this race, five times what our campaign has spent. In the last month alone, he spent $35 million. That’s as much as we’ve spent since the day we launched.**

Spending: TX-GOV
🔴 Abbott, total: $181 million

clean_body: We turned a long shot into a dead heat. Now we need to finish it. | | | | I wanted you to hear this from me first. A brand-new poll shows me leading Greg Abbott, 49% to 46%. Here’s why that number matters so much. In early October, we had cut Abbott’s lead to just 1.3 points. Then the polls started moving back his way. His lead in the polling average grew, and a lot of insiders decided this race was slipping away from us. This poll was taken in the middle of early voting, and it shows us ahead. What makes it remarkable is this: Greg Abbott has now spent $181 million in this race, five times what our campaign has spent. In the last month alone, he spent $35 million. That’s as much as we’ve spent since the day we launched. Spending: TX-GOV 🔴 Abbott, total: $181 million 🔴 Abbott, last 30 days: $35 million 🔵 Our entire campaign: $35 million He has outspent us 5 to 1. But we’re outworking him, and grassroots supporters are the reason why. I’m not going to pretend one poll settles anything. Three points is within the margin of error, and Abbott isn’t going to stop spending now. The voters who decide this race are about to be buried in his ads. We have to make sure they hear from us too. That’s why my team set a goal to raise $3 million this weekend, which would bring us to $10 million raised since October 1. As of writing this, we’re 95% of the way there. = = | | | Thank you, Gina | Equal Opportunity Now is d/b/a Reviving American Jobs Again PAC (RAJA PAC) Equal Opportunity Now P.O. name: Elaine Luria
subject: a little oy vey, a lot of resolve
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elaine Luria for Congress
body:
---
| | _Oy vey._ Elaine here. I told you I’d always give it to you straight, so here it is: **we fell short of our final end-of-month goal last night.** This couldn’t come at a worse moment.
* We have less than 48 hours to get out the vote across VA-02.
* _We need to be ready in the event of a recount._

You’ve heard it before: we must take action because democracy is at risk.
Donald Trump and his Republican allies have tried to manipulate elections. They know the playbook: voter suppression, election denial, intimidation at the polls, and gerrymandering. Put them together, and we steadily lose the ability to control our own futures.
But we are not afraid. This is a moment to channel outrage into action. And that is exactly how the Fair Fight team defends democracy.
I founded Fair Fight to advance voting rights after the 2018 election. When I saw eligible voters facing inexcusable barriers, I refused to be silent. I knew we needed a new coalition of patriots who would insist that every eligible voter can register to vote, cast their ballot, and have that ballot count.
Since then, the Fair Fight team has fought to protect those pillars of free and fair elections.
And in the run-up to Tuesday’s elections, they’ve strategically invested in races that are vital for turning back the tide on rising autocracy.
They’re fighting to flip the Georgia State House from red to blue, which is finally within reach after years of laying the groundwork. And they're fighting to elect Southern Democracy Champions to Congress who’ve stood up to new gerrymanders this year — and will keep fighting for fair maps and voting rights in Washington.
But these elections are hotly contested, and there’s a real chance we could fall just short of crucial victories. If MAGA Republicans cling to power, they will try to make that power permanent through more voter suppression and map-rigging. This is a pivot point for democracy — it could go either way.
[I’m asking you to donate to Fair Fight today because it would make a meaningful difference to elect Democracy Champions and preserve our freedoms.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142697801/657737727/-1736262579?refcode=emm_ff_20261101_SYALiftNote_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MGJkODFiNS0yZmQ2LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E1NDQ0MmUiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=z8_GBdD9IRnLpACTkbYf-3cUP8DKjno6YGlkQlGG-7s=)

Election Day is almost here — but Fair Fight’s monthly fundraising deadline will arrive even sooner at midnight tomorrow. And that is exactly how the Fair Fight team defends democracy. I founded Fair Fight to advance voting rights after the 2018 election. When I saw eligible voters facing inexcusable barriers, I refused to be silent. I knew we needed a new coalition of patriots who would insist that every eligible voter can register to vote, cast their ballot, and have that ballot count. And in the run-up to Tuesday’s elections, they’ve strategically invested in races that are vital for turning back the tide on rising autocracy. And they're fighting to elect Southern Democracy Champions to Congress who’ve stood up to new gerrymanders this year — and will keep fighting for fair maps and voting rights in Washington. But these elections are hotly contested, and there’s a real chance we could fall just short of crucial victories. Hi Derek, it's Amy
here with a personal message for you.

I'm beyond grateful for your support,
Derek. It doesn't go unnoticed.

I know you've been hearing a lot from me lately, but I promise that if it
weren’t necessary, I wouldn't be reaching out.

But I don't want to wake up in 2 days, wondering if there was anything
else more we could do.

Our race is a coin flip at this point,
Derek. It could literally come
down to a few hundred votes.

But right now, we're facing a significant budget gap – and we’re in the
middle of making our FINAL TV ad reservations.

So if we don't close the gap soon, we won't be able to fully fund our ads,
and Vivek will totally dominate the airwaves with his despicable, vile
attacks on me.

This would be the worst possible time to have to trim our
budgets, Derek.
Last minute TV ads can be the difference between winning and losing –
plain and simple.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22973?t=1002&akid=892%2E245147%2EkoRnpY ]That's why I decided to reach out to you today. My finance team and I
ran the numbers, and if every generous supporter chipped in $7 or more to
me and Josh Shapiro right now, we'd be able to fully fund the last of our
TV ads. Will you help us show Vivek Ramaswamy and his billionaire allies
the sheer strength of this grassroots campaign?

| | Friend,

I want to address recent headlines regarding ICE's increased presence in California, including here in the Bay Area.

Over the past month, we've followed horrifying stories of ICE employees arresting workers in the Central Valley, brandishing a firearm in San Francisco, and hospitalizing two people right here in the East Bay.

Despite these cases, I want to be clear: **As of right now, we are not observing a verified surge in immigration enforcement activity in the Bay Area.**

The reason I emphasize that point is twofold:
1. Even the _threat_ of an ICE surge can be enough to intimidate communities and keep people home.
2. Republicans are hoping to intimidate voters of color, and every exaggerated report of ICE activity, even if made with good intentions, does that work for them.

None of this is happening by accident.

**Republicans would rather frighten and threaten Latino and AAPI voters than earn their votes. At the same time, they know that a handful of violent arrests, amplified by the right-wing media ecosystem, will rile up their base.**

Using fear and violence to keep people from the ballot box is one of the oldest and ugliest tactics in American history. It is no surprise that Republicans are reaching for it again two weeks before an election that threatens to erase their majority in the House and potentially flip control of the Senate.

**If you're looking for ways to support our immigrant neighbors, take a look at the following resources:**
* **If you observe ICE activity in Alameda County, call the ACILEP hotline: 510-241-4011**
* Remember to **SALUTE** when giving a report (see graphic below)
* **Before you share a report of ICE activity on social media, check it with your local rapid response network**. False sightings and AI generated videos only help this Administration spread fear.
* **Remember your rights when interacting with ICE.**
* You have the right to remain silent. That includes the right to not answer any questions.
* You have the right not to disclose your identity to ICE.
* You do not have to open the door unless the agent has a valid judicial warrant signed by a judge.
* You have the right to speak to a lawyer and to refuse to sign any documents

**Gabe is the exact kind of patriot we need in Congress:**
**
* He served our country as an Army Black Hawk helicopter pilot in the Middle East.
* He protected his community as a police officer for over a decade.
* Today, he’s fighting for our conservative values in Congress.

**
**That's the kind of person we need fighting with us in Washington.**

**That's exactly why Radical Democrats are spending MILLIONS against him to drown out his message.**

**His opponent, Manny Rutinel, is one of the MOST Radical Socialists in America.**
**
* He’s a Vegan who has called agriculture “horrific” and “exploitative”.

* Was caught campaigning with Zohran Mamdani.

* He was arrested for running onto a football field during the game to protest oil and gas.

**
**And that's only scratching the surface...**
**Socialists like Manny Rutinel are rising up across the country and are doing everything they can to force their radical agenda into every zip code in America.**
**We must do everything we can to protect our Conservative House Majority and STOP this socialist takeover dead in its tracks.
[ That’s why I’m personally asking you to stand with Gabe Evans today and help him win one of the MOST important House races in America.](https://trk.emails.evansforcolorado.-KRCwlGY6cB_y7kTXSg)

Dear Patriot,

Right now, in campaign offices across this country, people are looking
at the new volunteer a little differently, and THAT'S EXACTLY WHY I
NEED YOU WITH ME
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Two weeks ago, I posted a warning to every midterm campaign in
America: “We have undercover people inside midterm campaigns across
the United States.” And I told them:

“I'm watching every single thing you ALL are doing.”

714,000 people saw that post. The campaigns saw it too. Then Detroit
came out, and a man who swore he could spot one of us from across the
room learned that he had been talking to one of my journalists all
along.

So what's on the other tapes? I CAN'T TELL YOU YET, and I want you to
understand exactly why, because the reason is the same thing that made
Detroit hold up the moment it went public.

I said in that same post that we would not release footage until we
had checked the facts, corroborated our sources and gotten comment, so
that every story was ABSOLUTELY BULLETPROOF. That promise is the most
expensive part of what we do. It means editors reviewing every hour of
raw footage, researchers checking every claim against the public
record, and calls to every person on tape to give them a chance to
explain. Then the lawyers read every word. HELP ME KEEP THAT PROMISE.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

[Absolutely bulletproof: editors, researchers, a call to every
person on tape, lawyers. If it needs one more source, it waits.]
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

It also means I won't rush. If a story is ready before Tuesday, you'll
see it. If it needs one more source, it waits. I would rather be right
than first, because when the denials come, and they always come, our
story has to be the one still standing.

Detroit showed what happens when we do it right: a campaign statement,
a party statement and a staffer who is no longer employed. The next
one will be held to the same standard. HELP ME GET IT OUT THE DOOR.
[https://link.email.america1stwarroom.

Covering the $47,000 we spent on Detroit is what lets my team stay
focused on the next release instead of the last bill. WE HAVE TWO DAYS
LEFT.

Greg Abbott has _never_ trailed in the polls in any of his campaigns for governor. But in just the last few weeks, it's happened to him seven times:

We have just two days until Election Day.
Two more days to reach every voter, help our friends and family get to the ballot box and finish this campaign strong. But before we get to the work ahead, I wanted to take a moment to say **thank you**.
If you spent part of your weekend knocking doors, calling voters and staying updated on this race, you've been an integral part of this campaign. I am grateful for every ounce of support.
**Where we stand**
As of today, more than 2.8 million North Carolinians have cast their ballot. I'm encouraged by that number and glad so many people voted early. It tells me North Carolinians are paying attention and that they care about what happens next.
But this race isn't over. Plenty of our neighbors, coworkers and classmates plan to vote on Tuesday, and many of them haven't yet settled on a plan for how to get there. Those are the people we are talking with now.
**Why every vote matters here**
If you've spent time in North Carolina politics, you probably know how these final moments go. Our elections are decided along the margins -- sometimes by a few thousand votes, and sometimes by far fewer.
So when I say every vote counts, I mean it. One conversation, one ride to the polls, one reminder text that Tuesday is Election Day could make all the difference in determining who will represent you in Raleigh and in Washington DC.
**The final stretch**
Over the next 48 hours, our organizers all across the state will be knocking doors and making calls to voters who haven't yet cast their ballot.
We have a special opportunity over the next 48 hours to cement everything this campaign has built and to make sure everyone's hard work is seen when the polls close.
If you're ready to help them in this final stretch, you can sign up to [volunteer here](https://substack.com/redirect/46b6a6bc-ac36-4294-8aa0-8b2252fe008d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [chip in whatever you can here](https://substack.com/redirect/217169c5-6bcd-4c4a-83e2-af34a905fcae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). body:
Three states are about to decide a lot more than 2026.

| | | |
---
Friend,
---
We've looked at the polling in every swing state and swing race in the country. It's margin of error, either way, almost everywhere.

At this point, it's not about winning anybody over. _It's about who actually shows up._

If conservatives turn out in November, we'll win every critical battleground and lay the groundwork for victory in 2028 and beyond.

That's why Turning Point Action is focusing all our efforts on three key states: Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire.

**We call these states the new RED WALL.**

_Let us explain why they matter so much... _

After 2024, Charlie looked at the numbers, looked at the maps, and told our team something simple. If we lock down Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire, the Left's entire strategy falls apart. Their map collapses. Their path back to power disappears.

Here's why... Winning the presidency comes down to 270 electoral votes. Lose Arizona and most of the realistic paths to the White House in 2028 are gone. Lose Nevada and New Hampshire and the Left rebuilds the Blue Wall they lost in 2024.

Whoever wins in 2028 controls the 2030 Census. The Census drives redistricting. Redistricting sets the congressional map for the next ten years.

This midterm decides which way that goes.
---

We ran the most sophisticated ballot-chasing operation the Right has ever put together, and we won every single state where we ran it. 10 for 10. Now we're doing it again, in the three states that decide everything this time. | | There's a lot of noise out there right now. We can't be distracted. Some people would love for the last days of this race to be about politicians. Who said what. Who's mad at whom. Screenshots and hot takes. **I will not be distracted.** Every minute spent talking about politicians is a minute taken from the people this election is really about: working Michiganders. — This election is about the dad I met who told me his kid is really good at baseball but can't play next year because he just can't afford it. — This election is about everyone who's been told to wait for relief to "trickle down" while groceries, rent, and healthcare slip further out of reach. — And it's about people far beyond our state. Because Michigan will decide control of the United States Senate. A Democratic Senate is how we put a check on Donald Trump's power. Mike Rogers, Trump's handpicked candidate, wants to be one more vote for the same billionaire agenda that's been fleecing Michigan for decades. Please don't get distracted by the political drama. I promise you I won't. Election Day is Tuesday. Several polls show us statistically tied with Mike Rogers. # Mansharamani Musings

| | [](https://us.list-manage.com/KMqF85ak9jf?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586)October had lots of developments that demanded attention. Producer prices rose faster than consumer prices, France ignited, and the bond market rioted. The AI boom attracted a lot of doubters, with rapidly spreading concerns that the bubble was bursting. And, surprise surprise, the American midterm elections increasingly dominated the news. See below for links to my thoughts about these (and other) topics as well as a midterm preview from a friend and DC insider...

| | **OCTOBER 4, 2026**

Interest rates are on an upward march. The 10-year Treasury just hit 5.33%; the 30-year hit 5.69%. Those are 24-year highs. But this is not just an American phenomenon. The UK 30-year punched through 6% for the first time since 1998. France’s 10-year hit its highest since 2002. The bond market is telegraphing distress.

What is going on? The answer comes down to three forces. And they’re all connected.
**1\. Inflation: Stimulus & War**The inflation story started with COVID. Governments flooded their economies with trillions in stimulus, central banks monetized it, and demand came roaring back before supply chains could. That was the first wave. The second wave came from two wars. Russia’s invasion of Ukraine rapidly and massively disrupted the energy and grain markets, beginning in 2022 but continuing to the present. The Iran war compounded an already problematic situation: Goldman Sachs called the Iran War the largest oil...

| | **OCTOBER 11, 2026**
The frozen pizza business is booming...and that’s concerning. That probably sounds strange. But not if you understand what frozen pizza actually _is,_ economically speaking. Frozen pizza isn’t a product. It’s a _signal_. And right now, the signal is flashing red.
You see, frozen pizza thrives when the economy doesn’t. In 2009, at the depths of the Great Recession, frozen pizza sales surged while restaurants sat empty. When COVID hit in 2020, [sales jumped roughly a billion dollars in a single year](https://us.list-manage.com/fLYNyXNrZGJ?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586), from $5.6 billion to $6.6 billion. The pattern is proving so reliable, it’s almost mechanical: when families start trading down from dining out to eating in, that journey includes regular stops in the frozen food aisle.
And right now? The frozen aisle is as busy as ever.

In March, [QatarEnergy declared _force majeure_](https://us.list-manage.com/kF94dYDhwXt?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586) on its natural gas exports. One announcement, one simple sentence. And just like that, twenty percent of the world’s liquefied natural gas (LNG) supply went offline. Seven months later, it’s still dark. [In the first six months of the war](https://us.list-manage.com/zHtMiLTO5VZ?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586), Qatar shipped 18 LNG cargoes. In the same period the year before, it shipped 509. The lost sales are valued at around $24 billion. As of this writing, there’s still no firm date for resumption.
Natural gas supplies [about a quarter of the world’s energy](https://us.list-manage.com/9OiKPyIg2So?e=93b2c2b824&c2id=8d3705edc40ffd26940a732b7f12f586), and LNG (gas chilled to negative 162 degrees Celsius until it liquefies and shrinks to one six-hundredth of its volume) is how it crosses oceans to countries that need it most. | | **OCTOBER 25, 2026**

In 1972, a journalist asked Chinese Premier Zhou Enlai about the impact of the French Revolution. His answer, the story goes, was, “It’s too early to say.” The line has become a staple of geopolitical commentary. It’s a great reminder that revolutions unfold on very long timelines (and that the Chinese generally think about dynamics over the long-term compared vs. the short attention spans of the West). Interestingly, some thought Enlai was being asked about the then-more-recent 1968 student protests that had rocked the country, but whether he was referring to 1789 or 1968, the quote is worth keeping in mind, because, as this weekend’s activity showed, the next revolution seems to be underway.
It started with a high school in Créteil. On September 21, the day after their teachers went on strike, students at the Lycée Antoine-de-Saint-Exupéry in the Paris suburbs walked out over unfilled teaching posts, classroom sizes of 35, and rooms without enough tables. By the end of the month, more than a thousand lycées were disrupted. On one day in particular, French police had arrested nearly 2,000 people (mostly minors). Within a month, the unrest had grown from just students to include teachers, parents, unions, farmers and Yellow Vest veterans.
