| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE****Date:** November 1, 2026 **Contact:**[ Taylor Gillespie](mailto:taylorg@eileenforcolorado.com), 720-557-6185
---
| | **From Afghanistan to Colorado’s 4th District: Retired Rear Admiral Eileen Laubacher Reflects on a Lifetime of Service in Final Campaign Ad**
_Final ad will air during Sunday’s Broncos game ahead of Election Day_
---
| |
**HIGHLANDS RANCH, CO** — Retired Rear Admiral Eileen Laubacher has released the closing ad of her campaign, highlighting her lifelong commitment to serving her country. That commitment began when she joined the Navy at 17, carried her through 34 years of military service, including a deployment to Afghanistan in 2009, and continues today as she runs to represent Colorado’s 4th Congressional District. The ad opens with Eileen recalling the moment she felt called to serve in Afghanistan. After learning that the Navy was preparing for a large-scale mobilization of officers at her rank, she attended church with her family, where a hymn was sung that struck a deeply personal chord: **“I will go, Lord, if you lead me, I will hold your people in my heart. That’s when I knew that I was being called to go,” said Laubacher.** In 2009, she deployed to Afghanistan, leaving behind her husband and five young children for a year. Over the last year and a half, Laubacher has traveled extensively throughout the district, covering more than 40,000 miles, visiting all 21 counties, meeting with staff at all 14 rural hospitals, attending community events, and hearing directly from the people of this district about the challenges facing their families and their communities. **“This job is not actually supposed to be about the person who holds it – this job is about the people of the 4th District, who have real challenges in their lives, who need someone who shows up, and listens,” Laubacher says in the ad. “I don’t serve a party. I serve you, the people of this district.”** As voters head to the polls, Laubacher reflects on a lifetime of service, expressing gratitude and reaffirming her commitment to the people of the Colorado’s 4th district : **“I’ve dedicated my life to service of my country, and it’s been an honor and a privilege to have another chance to serve my community. I am so grateful to all those who have supported me and volunteered with my campaign, for your trust and your time. As your Congresswoman, I will hold every person in Colorado’s 4th District in my heart, and will always put you first.”**[**Watch the full ad, Service Story, here**](https://us.list-manage.com/bl7wTUjKFRd?e=1c5f08419c&c2id=9f711ebcee4618a2092828a4c98e410a)**###**

Hi team,
I know your inbox is probably full of emails asking you for money right now. Mine is too.
I'm not going to lie to you, I'm also going to ask you to chip in if you can. But there's a really good reason for it.
**The opportunity we have here is once in a generation.**
Since taking office, Dan Meuser has doubled his net worth to over $69 million and held zero town halls.
He doesn't live here. He gave our health care money to his billionaire donors. He voted to give tax breaks to data centers and take away local control while buying and selling millions in AI stocks.
**We have the chance to hold him accountable and make real change. To replace him with someone who shows up, listens, and fights for us.**
Dan has never faced a challenger with this much grassroots support, or voters this fed up. We can do this. But we have to do it together.
**[Election Day is in two days. If you believe our part of PA deserves better, chip in today and help me fight for it.](https://substack.com/redirect/6b0d3f90-4d5f-4f35-abd4-def04430b963?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Friend, Today is the last day of early voting in New Jersey, and Election Day is this Tuesday, November 3rd. If you haven't voted yet, now is the time to make your plan. **You can still vote early today.** Early voting sites are open until 6 pm today. You can vote at any early voting site in your county, not just the one closest to home. Registered Israeli agent Abby Rosner, spokesperson for Mike Rogers, stands behind Rep. Haley Stevens, a Michigan Democrat defeated by Abdul El-Sayed in the Senate primary, as she endorses Rogers after attending the Perfecting Church in Detroit, Michigan November 1, 2026. REUTERS/Rebecca Cook.
Abigail Ronson, a spokesperson for the Mike Rogers campaign, is a registered foreign agent for the state of Israel--one of two foreign agents working on the Rogers campaign, according to a review of foreign agent registration records.
Ronson, a ubiquitous presence on the campaign trail and in interactions with reporters, has been working on the Rogers campaign through major vendor Convergence Media. The campaign has paid Convergence millions this election cycle, according to FEC reports.
Ronson, who used to work for Senate Majority Speaker Mike Johnson, is a digital communications specialist at Convergence. In a May FARA filing, she also registered as a foreign agent for Israel, doing work for HAVAS Media Network via Brad Parscale's Clocktower X LLC.
Ronson was spotted Sunday behind Rogers and former Democratic contender for the seat Rep. Haley Stevens at a press conference on Sunday after Stevens's surprise endorsement of Rogers over Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed.
Drop Site is funded by readers, not foreign governments. Become a paying subscriber to support this work.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZHJvcHNpdGVuZXdzLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.ilk7mM9ZdbciiujSFssBKFJ3LE0cRNu95S3KUsNmd4g?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=223071390)
Ronson is joined by at least one other Israeli agent on the campaign: Jesse Stokes is another Convergence Media staffer who registered as a foreign agent [in October](https://substack.com/redirect/c37c7337-15ef-4252-9a90-cd831f9068c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 2025 as part of the Havas contract. Stokes appears to pen many of Rogers' press releases, and is the author on the April press releases announcing his Senate run, according to the document metadata.
Neither Rosner nor Stokes responded immediately to a request for comment. A second Rogers' spokesperson, not on the Israeli payroll, did not immediately respond to questions as to whether the campaign was aware of the arrangement.
Ronson was reportedly responsible for the ["buff" AI Mike Rogers photo](https://substack.com/redirect/0ed1a807-5178-4e7b-9b43-1f08382b083d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that went viral earlier this year. She also helped organize a press conference for the "Democrats For Mike Rogers" group of allegedly disillusioned Democratic voters--which, according to Drop Site reporting, [appears to be](https://substack.com/redirect/fcfbcc75-c13f-4183-a4ad-c69a25467aff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a sloppy, astroturfed campaign.
Ronson is one of 14 Convergence staffers subcontracted by former Trump campaign manager Brad Parscale to [push pro-Israel views](https://substack.com/redirect/efe1f75c-23f4-4162-ab05-1dbd421fedf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on social media and even seed LLMs with pro-Israel information, all part of a $46.5 million contract with the Israel government. Convergence is a "campaign strategy, digital, public affairs & media firm" led by longtime GOP operative and Parscale ally, Mike Shields. Parscale's Israel work is paid through Havas Media Network, and has created AI text message campaigns, and launched paid ads on Parscale's media network Salem Media.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2063b560-960c-484b-a42e-b480c5287c0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/005d0274-f98c-4777-affd-e8c7c6c6af23?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8181f44a-ce2c-460c-886e-d16bdef50ae4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Ronson's registration says the services will include "strategic communications, planning, and media services in support of Havas' engagement by the State of Israel to develop and execute a nationwide campaign in the United States to combat anti-semitism."
The Rogers campaign [denied ](https://substack.com/redirect/0a89c2a7-4045-485d-aa45-55c2035f1e9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Ronson was a staffer in June when she was identified as making the AI muscular Rogers image, and there are no direct FEC payments to her from the campaign. But she has been making statements as a campaign spokesperson to media outlets--including to Drop Site News, using an official Rogers campaign email address, and the New York Times--as recently as this week. That email address also appears in the metadata of a PDF document posted by the campaign website, announcing the launch of "Democrats for Mike Rogers" in August.
The treasurer for the super PAC funding Democrats for Mike Rogers Karen Whitsett appeared on Lara Trump's Fox show this weekend, billed only as a disaffected Michigan voter. That super PAC, Together for Michigan, has spent $5 million attacking El-Sayed. It has received money from Republican political appointees such as Mara Saad ($100,000), Trump megadonor Robert Soave ($100,000) and top Michigan Republican megadonor Robert Penske ($250,000), and the Great Lakes Conservatives Fund--which is reportedly itself due for a $9 million infusion of cash from AIPAC, according to[ The New York Times](https://substack.com/redirect/54605d22-daa4-406c-bdef-e77e86a788d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The Great Lakes Conservatives Fund, which makes up the single biggest source of funding for "Democrats for Mike Rogers," chipping in more than $4 million so far, has a history working with an AI company run by Parscale that [he uses](https://substack.com/redirect/89cce4b2-1c25-4aab-9fcf-7f73a61a747c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for his Israeli FARA work, Eyesover LLC.

Peter,

If you’ve been keeping an eye on the fight to retake a Democratic majority in the Senate, you probably already know that competitive seats in states like Maine, Texas, and Alaska are currently in play for Democrats. That is massively exciting news.

But as much as I want Democrats to win those races, we have to be realistic about the math. The fact of the matter is that **Republicans only need to flip Michigan in order to hold onto their majority.**

If they flip this seat in Michigan, our chances at winning the Senate are _toast_.

I don’t say all this to scare you, but I want to be honest about what this means for our race:
* Republicans have made me their**#1 target to beat** in November, and they are dropping $1 million a day on ads from now until Election Day.

* That means the hundreds of thousands of Michiganders who are currently choosing whether to vote for me, Mike Rogers, or whether to even vote at all are being**swamped with attack ads** in this final push.

We have already defied the odds once and fought this race to a virtual tie. Now, we have to finish the job. The window to make a difference in the outcome of this race is closing fast, so if you’ve been waiting for the right moment to make a contribution to our campaign, _this is it_. **[Will you please donate $10 to my campaign and Patty Murray so we can hold onto this must-win Senate seat? body:
We’re almost there. We can win this.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, I want to be straight with you, because you’ve earned that.
Back in April, I was down almost 7 points to Greg Abbott in the polling average. Political insiders wrote this race off. Then you showed up: you chipped in, spread the word, and proved that people all over the country believe Texas can be taken back. **By October 7, we had cut that gap to just 1.3 points.**
I know a lot of you saw that number and felt what I felt: _we can actually do this._
Today, the average has me trailing Abbott by 2.6 points. But that number doesn’t tell the whole story. Just days ago, a new poll showed me ahead, 49% to 46%. Others show Abbott up by a few points. **Put it all together, and this race is within the margin of error.**
Here’s what I need you to hear: **we are on the edge of doing something no one thought was possible.** This is one of the most competitive governor’s races in the country, and it will be decided by turnout, by organizing, and by what we do in these final days.
Election Day is on Tuesday, and every dollar we raise right now goes straight into reaching the voters who will decide this thing. We can’t get comfortable. Not for a single day.**We have to make sure every voter hears the truth about Greg Abbott before they cast their ballot.**
_**Your donation could be the difference between winning and losing.**_ It could decide whether Texas gets four more years of Greg Abbott’s corruption or whether we take Texas back.
I’ve never needed your support more. [**Will you chip in $15 now so we can close this gap on Tuesday?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1374?c0=em_ms_gh_20261101_3_polls.ewc1nG&refcode=em20261101-2606&t=5&akid=2606%2E299639%2EuwCKjD)

Back in April, I was down 7. With Election Day just around the corner, this race is within the margin of error. We’re this close, but it’s now or never, and I need you with me today.
Thank you,
Gina

clean_body: We’re almost there. We can win this. Peter, I want to be straight with you, because you’ve earned that. Back in April, I was down almost 7 points to Greg Abbott in the polling average. Political insiders wrote this race off. Then you showed up: you chipped in, spread the word, and proved that people all over the country believe Texas can be taken back. By October 7, we had cut that gap to just 1.3 points. I know a lot of you saw that number and felt what I felt: we can actually do this. Today, the average has me trailing Abbott by 2.6 points. But that number doesn’t tell the whole story. Just days ago, a new poll showed me ahead, 49% to 46%. Others show Abbott up by a few points. Put it all together, and this race is within the margin of error. Here’s what I need you to hear: we are on the edge of doing something no one thought was possible. This is one of the most competitive governor’s races in the country, and it will be decided by turnout, by organizing, and by what we do in these final days. Election Day is on Tuesday, and every dollar we raise right now goes straight into reaching the voters who will decide this thing. We can’t get comfortable. Not for a single day.We have to make sure every voter hears the truth about Greg Abbott before they cast their ballot. Your donation could be the difference between winning and losing. It could decide whether Texas gets four more years of Greg Abbott’s corruption or whether we take Texas back. I’ve never needed your support more. Back in April, I was down 7. With Election Day just around the corner, this race is within the margin of error. We’re this close, but it’s now or never, and I need you with me today. name: Roy Cooper
subject: On a positive note
body:
We can’t count our chickens before they hatch.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1769&source=&t=1&akid=5043%2E124072%2EK0cXxn) | | | |

Hey there, Peter –
Remember how I told you that due to a dip in small-dollar donations across the board, our campaign was forced to make some big cuts to our projections?
Well, I’ve got some good news to share: Grassroots support has made quite the comeback.
In fact, we’re currently on pace to hit our final get-out-the-vote fundraising goals – and I couldn’t be more grateful.
**Now, we just have to _stay_ on track.**
I understand that things appear to be going our way. From the most recent polls to the expert predictions to President Trump’s own admission in Greenville the other week, all signs point to us flipping North Carolina blue for the first time since 2008 – but it’s not a done deal yet.
We have one last opportunity to raise the grassroots funds to get the job done in two days. The worst thing we could do is get complacent and waste it by coming up short of our last fundraising goals.
**However, if I can count on just 27 more supporters from Englewood reading this right now to chip in $5, we’ll stay on course to reach our goal in time.**

name: Abdul El-Sayed (via Democrats.org)
subject: Who this election is actually about
body:
Don’t get pulled into the noise. Lock in. Focus on one thing: getting every Democrat in Michigan to the polls on Tuesday. [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/87341?t=1&akid=10211%2E22930333%2ElpO_Oq)
---
| [](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-el-sayed-split.RVKDo5&amount=20&refcode=em_20261101_10211_fr&t=6&akid=10211%2E22930333%2ElpO_Oq)
---
Derek, there's a lot of noise out there right now. We can’t be distracted.
Some people would love for the last days of this race to be about politicians. Who said what. Who's mad at whom. Screenshots and hot takes.
**I will not be distracted.** Every minute spent talking about politicians is a minute taken from the people this election is really about: working Michiganders.
— This election is about the dad I met who told me his kid is really good at baseball but can't play next year because he just can't afford it.
— This election is about everyone who's been told to wait for relief to “trickle down” while groceries, rent, and healthcare slip further out of reach.
— And it's about people far beyond our state. Because Michigan may decide control of the United States Senate. A Democratic Senate is how we put a check on Donald Trump's power. Mike Rogers, Trump's handpicked candidate, wants to be one more vote for the same billionaire agenda that's been fleecing Michigan.
Please don’t get distracted by the political drama. I promise you I won’t.
Election Day is Tuesday. Several polls show us statistically tied with Mike Rogers. In 2024, the Senate race here came down to under 20,000 votes.
**I’m told there's still time to put our final get-out-the-vote ads in front of Michigan voters, but only if we have the cash to run them right now.**
[**Please split a donation of $20 or any amount right now to fund the DNC and our last get-out-the-vote ads before polls close on Tuesday.**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-el-sayed-split.RVKDo5&refcode=em_20261101_10211_fr&amount=20&t=7&akid=10211%2E22930333%2ElpO_Oq)

subject: With two days to go, I want to say thank you.
body:
Dear Peter, It’s Sunday before Election Day. We have two days left, and it’s time to leave it all on the field. But before we do, I want to take a moment to say _thank you_. To our incredible campaign staff, a small but mighty team that has been with me from the very beginning. To our interns and the countless volunteers who have made thousands of calls to Vermonters. To everyone who has written a letter to the editor, posted on Front Porch Forum, opened your kitchen or living room to a conversation, or welcomed me to your downtown, your farm, your town hall, or your town green. You have given your time, your energy, your homes, and your hearts to this campaign. _And we are here because of you._ From the beginning, this campaign has been about building a coalition of Vermonters ready to do the hard and important work ahead: lowering costs, fighting for working families and those on fixed incomes, and protecting the rights of every Vermonter. So let's get out the vote, keep talking to our neighbors, and make every conversation count. I can't wait to see you out there. body:
Then he took it right out of my hand.

| [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7jTQa_woVAQw3G3alAYtUbYQyTJkeoL9-8ATbJdqy0seEjjkr4_5A2KK-_oTMtpKYa7nTBuGJVYEnz8xQ0wnbbjThrMSquVSciFncBRfOBtovPXOg3QNWtkN-tkJo_tms0Nvus5rr6B79oNs-94MQiujg1MLStVEe--TUkilhNDtQ5seRAAfnnJoOyOYEZCw0qPicS0pOtgJzt-hVIcPV3KT7EZ0nEz_YGpiajrRXRUfsKMvdBNMTSkuWOmTrxdUf-eVl7zysEQOIUQPr0g8L_woBzA9XZTns1zVIdPj_1im2pvJ6OOVmR7fc_9qDvIBcd2ZHr_MvjplJ9yJ6bFSYKqFXK531M-mWn_8iSnFs-2YEet98bcdffMhL6v-BgAA__9RdpyF)

O'Keefe Defense Fund • Legal Update
Dear Patriot,Early one morning in November 2021, FBI agents showed up at my home with a search warrant, and I asked to call my lawyer.An agent handed me my phone and I unlocked it to make the call. **Then he took it right out of my hand.** My name is James O'Keefe. I run O'Keefe Media Group, and for eighteen years I have sent undercover reporters into rooms that do not want a camera in them.[](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7jTQa_woVAQw3G3alAYtUbYQyTJkeoL9-8ATbJdqy0seEjjkr4_5A2KK-_oTMtpKYa7nTBuGJVYEnz8xQ0wnbbjThrMSquVSciFncBRfOBtovPXOg3QNWtkN-tkJo_tms0Nvus5rr6B79oNs-94MQiujg1MLStVEe--TUkilhNDtQ5seRAAfnnJoOyOYEZCw0qPicS0pOtgJzt-hVIcPV3KT7EZ0nEz_YGpiajrRXRUfsKMvdBNMTSkuWOmTrxdUf-eVl7zysEQOIUQPr0g8L_woBzA9XZTns1zVIdPj_1im2pvJ6OOVmR7fc_9qDvIBcd2ZHr_MvjplJ9yJ6bFSYKqFXK531M-mWn_8iSnFs-2YEet98bcdffMhL6v-BgAA__9RdpyF)For almost five years, the government's reasons for that raid were sealed. This year a federal judge ruled that the secrecy had gone too far, so the FBI's sworn affidavit is now public, and I have read every page of it. | [CHIP IN $35 TO DEFEND JAMES ->](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7jTQa_woVAQw3G3alAYtUbYQyTJkeoL9-8ATbJdqy0seEjjkr4_5A2KK-_oTMtpKYa7nTBuGJVYEnz8xQ0wnbbjThrMSquVSciFncBRfOBtovPXOg3QNWtkN-tkJo_tms0Nvus5rr6B79oNs-94MQiujg1MLStVEe--TUkilhNDtQ5seRAAfnnJoOyOYEZCw0qPicS0pOtgJzt-hVIcPV3KT7EZ0nEz_YGpiajrRXRUfsKMvdBNMTSkuWOmTrxdUf-eVl7zysEQOIUQPr0g8L_woBzA9XZTns1zVIdPj_1im2pvJ6OOVmR7fc_9qDvIBcd2ZHr_MvjplJ9yJ6bFSYKqFXK531M-mWn_8iSnFs-2YEet98bcdffMhL6v-BgAA__9RdpyF)
---
**The FBI already had my emails** before it came to my door, because it had used search warrants to collect them from Microsoft.
That means agents read the email I sent my team on October 12, 2020, after a tipster brought us a diary that was said to belong to Joe Biden's daughter. In it, I told my team we would not publish the diary, because it was **" indefensible to publish what we currently have."**
Nine days later I wrote to them again: **" We can't publish this."**
The FBI quoted both of those emails in its own sworn affidavit, and more than a year later, it raided my home anyway.
[DONATE NOW ->](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckbuO3DAMRb9G7jTQa_woVAQw3G3alAYtUbYQyTJkeoL9-8ATbJdqy0seEjjkr4_5A2KK-_oTMtpKYa7nTBuGJVYEnz8xQ0wnbbjThrMSquVSciFncBRfOBtovPXOg3QNWtkN-tkJo_tms0Nvus5rr6B79oNs-94MQiujg1MLStVEe--TUkilhNDtQ5seRAAfnnJoOyOYEZCw0qPicS0pOtgJzt-hVIcPV3KT7EZ0nEz_YGpiajrRXRUfsKMvdBNMTSkuWOmTrxdUf-eVl7zysEQOIUQPr0g8L_woBzA9XZTns1zVIdPj_1im2pvJ6OOVmR7fc_9qDvIBcd2ZHr_MvjplJ9yJ6bFSYKqFXK531M-mWn_8iSnFs-2YEet98bcdffMhL6v-BgAA__9RdpyF)
---
The same agent swore that it "does not appear" my reporters **" are, in fact, credentialed journalists."** Agents tracked my phone to a hotel upstate and planned to wait until I came home, and they even asked the judge for the power to press my fingers onto my phone and hold it up to my face to unlock it.
And after all of that, **the government never charged me with a single crime.** The judge said so in her own order: "no criminal charges were forthcoming."
They never needed a conviction, because a raid works just as well if it costs a reporter years of lawyers, money, and focus. Liberty Guard runs the O'Keefe Defense Fund so that I can pay those lawyers and keep doing the reporting they wanted to stop.

If everyone reading this donated literally $1, we wouldn’t just reach our goals. We wouldn’t just receive a huge number of donations. We would have the resources to turn out an absolutely monumental coalition on November 3rd. We’d beat Mike Lawler and take back the House.

Unlike Mike, Cait doesn’t depend on a handful of billionaires to bail this campaign out. We’re powered by grassroots donations. We’re really hoping we can count on you.

[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, Donald Trump
is watching Pennsylvania for a reason.

If he gets his hands on the Governor’s office this year, there will be no
one to stop him from overturning a free and fair election here in
Pennsylvania and guarantee our electoral votes go to his chosen candidate
come 2028.

That’s what’s at stake in this election,
Derek. Not just Pennsylvania’s
future. But our entire country’s future. Our entire democracy’s future.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22817?t=1001&akid=915%2E245147%2Eq2UbAW ]So I need to ask: Will you make your first $5 donation right
now to make sure we hold the line here in the final two days of this
election?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22817?t=1002&akid=915%2E245147%2Eq2UbAW ]Donate →

Look, I really wish it didn’t cost so much money to win an election.

But this is Pennsylvania. In 2024, we saw $1.2 BILLION worth of campaign
ads in the lead up to the election... and Republicans still won every
statewide election on the ballot.

That’s an eye-watering sum of money,
Derek. And since I’m one of
just two Democratic Governors nationwide running for reelection in a state
Trump won?

Pennsylvania is still at the very top of the GOP’s wish list.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/22817?t=1003&akid=915%2E245147%2Eq2UbAW ]This is the point in the election when just one extra ad or one extra
organizer can swing an extraordinary amount of voters. So please, will you
give as much as you can to help us expand our final ad buy, break out of
our fundraising slump, and keep the most important swing state in the
country out of Donald Trump’s hands?

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: I’m not sure what Mike Rogers would say if he were asked the same question
disclaimer_text: paid for by people
body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1001&akid=3834%2E251025%2ExvCaEy ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/1219?t=1002&akid=3834%2E251025%2ExvCaEy ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter,

I know you hear from a lot of campaigns this time of year, so before I
share something with you, I want to tell you up front why I'm writing.

There are just a couple of days left until Election Day. Mike Rogers has
MAGA Republicans in his corner, and they’ve committed over $157 million to
flip this seat. I don't take corporate PAC money. That means every ad we
run and every door we knock between now and Tuesday is paid for by people
like you.

Last month, I wrote a column for the Lansing City Pulse about why I'm
running. I want to share it with you, because it's the clearest answer I
can give you about what your support is for.

But first, I have to ask: can you chip in $10 or any amount
to fuel our work? We’re counting on your support to spread the word about
what our campaign is fighting for.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261101-5-ak.Fd-mlI&amount=10&refcode=em20261101-3834&t=1004&akid=3834%2E251025%2ExvCaEy ]https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20261101-5-ak

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

I’m running because our kids are the whole point.

At a recent town hall in Grand Rapids, a young boy asked me a question:
"What was the driving factor for you to run for Senator?"

I didn't have to think twice. My answer was as simple as it was automatic:
"You."

As a father, my "why" in this race has always been clear. Our kids are the
whole point. In every child, I see my own children.

[ Abdul ]Abdul playing with his two daughters

My brilliant daughters, Emmalee and Serene, are eight and three. I'm
running for Senate because I want them to grow up in a world where they
and all the children they're growing up with have a shot at the future
they deserve.

But right now, our politics are keeping that out of reach. For far too
long, billionaires and corporations have rigged the system against us all.
Special interests buy and sell politicians while everyday Michiganders
strain under record-breaking costs and stagnating wages. Utilities,
insurance premiums, mortgages, gas and groceries — none of them are
affordable alone. Together, they're pushing us to the brink.

I'm running for Senate because in the richest, most powerful country in
the world, it shouldn't be this hard to simply get by. That's why I've
never taken a dime of corporate money and never will. And on day one as
Michigan's next Senator, I will champion legislation to overturn the
catastrophic Citizens United ruling to get corporate money out of our
politics — so that we can finally build the world our children deserve.

I’m not sure what Mike Rogers would say if he were asked the same
question. We may never know, because he doesn't do town halls where such
questions are often asked. Considering the consequences of the full scope
of his career, his honest answer would likely be the exact opposite: "To
make more money."

We've seen what happens when Mike Rogers gets a taste of power. We've
suffered through it before.

Rogers spent twenty years in the state Senate and then in Congress abusing
his office to enrich himself at the expense of Michiganders.

He took money from Big Oil — then voted to keep gas prices high.

He took money from Wall Street — then voted for higher credit rates.

He took money from Big Pharma — then voted to gut Medicaid and raise
prescription drug costs.

And upon leaving Congress, he spun through the revolving door to rake in
millions by advising the very corporations he was supposed to regulate in
office.

Mike Rogers has never met a billionaire or a corporation he wouldn't
eagerly sell us out to. We know this to be true: life gets harder for
Michiganders when Mike Rogers is in charge. Because, like his puppet
master Trump, Rogers represents the worst in our politics.

As I've crisscrossed the state over the past year, I've had a chance to
speak with voters of all backgrounds. We've held over 600 events in each
corner of Michigan, and everywhere I go, I hear the same concerns. Trump
is running wild in Washington without any checks or balances, and it has
led us into a disastrous trade war with Canada as well as an immoral
regime change in Iran. Mike Rogers has only cheered Trump's extreme
policies, and, if elected, he'd rubber-stamp them without a second
thought.

Folks can't afford their groceries. Gas is too expensive. Young people
worry they'll never be able to hold a job or own a home, and healthcare
access continues to be stripped away.

This November, we can do something about that.

We can get money out of politics. We can put money in your pocket. And we
can deliver Medicare for All.

This election is a referendum on politics as usual.

We have a choice between a government that serves Michigan or a government
that serves Donald Trump and the corporations from which he's enriching
himself.

Michiganders, the choice is yours. Our children are counting on us.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------

Peter, that's
the column. Here's the part I didn't have room to say in the paper.

I can't keep that promise to Emmalee and Serene, or to that kid in Grand
Rapids, all on my own. Mike Rogers is banking on his corporate backers to
carry him into the Senate. I'm counting on you.

So please, contribute $10 or any amount today so that we can
keep putting Mike Rogers's record in front of Michigan voters — on the
air, at the doors, and at every town hall he won't show up to — through
Election Day.

clean_body: [ ]Abdul for US Senate [ ]Abdul for US Senate Peter, I know you hear from a lot of campaigns this time of year, so before I share something with you, I want to tell you up front why I'm writing. There are just a couple of days left until Election Day. Mike Rogers has MAGA Republicans in his corner, and they’ve committed over $157 million to flip this seat. I don't take corporate PAC money. That means every ad we run and every door we knock between now and Tuesday is paid for by people like you. Last month, I wrote a column for the Lansing City Pulse about why I'm running. I want to share it with you, because it's the clearest answer I can give you about what your support is for. But first, I have to ask: can you chip in $10 or any amount to fuel our work? We’re counting on your support to spread the word about what our campaign is fighting for. [ ] I’m running because our kids are the whole point. At a recent town hall in Grand Rapids, a young boy asked me a question: "What was the driving factor for you to run for Senator?" I didn't have to think twice. My answer was as simple as it was automatic: "You." As a father, my "why" in this race has always been clear. Our kids are the whole point. In every child, I see my own children. [ Abdul ]Abdul playing with his two daughters My brilliant daughters, Emmalee and Serene, are eight and three. I'm running for Senate because I want them to grow up in a world where they and all the children they're growing up with have a shot at the future they deserve. But right now, our politics are keeping that out of reach. For far too long, billionaires and corporations have rigged the system against us all. Special interests buy and sell politicians while everyday Michiganders strain under record-breaking costs and stagnating wages. Utilities, insurance premiums, mortgages, gas and groceries — none of them are affordable alone. Together, they're pushing us to the brink. I'm running for Senate because in the richest, most powerful country in the world, it shouldn't be this hard to simply get by. That's why I've never taken a dime of corporate money and never will. And on day one as Michigan's next Senator, I will champion legislation to overturn the catastrophic Citizens United ruling to get corporate money out of our politics — so that we can finally build the world our children deserve. I’m not sure what Mike Rogers would say if he were asked the same question. We may never know, because he doesn't do town halls where such questions are often asked. Considering the consequences of the full scope of his career, his honest answer would likely be the exact opposite: "To make more money." We've seen what happens when Mike Rogers gets a taste of power. We've suffered through it before. Rogers spent twenty years in the state Senate and then in Congress abusing his office to enrich himself at the expense of Michiganders. He took money from Big Oil — then voted to keep gas prices high. He took money from Wall Street — then voted for higher credit rates. He took money from Big Pharma — then voted to gut Medicaid and raise prescription drug costs. And upon leaving Congress, he spun through the revolving door to rake in millions by advising the very corporations he was supposed to regulate in office. Mike Rogers has never met a billionaire or a corporation he wouldn't eagerly sell us out to. We know this to be true: life gets harder for Michiganders when Mike Rogers is in charge. Because, like his puppet master Trump, Rogers represents the worst in our politics. As I've crisscrossed the state over the past year, I've had a chance to speak with voters of all backgrounds. We've held over 600 events in each corner of Michigan, and everywhere I go, I hear the same concerns. Trump is running wild in Washington without any checks or balances, and it has led us into a disastrous trade war with Canada as well as an immoral regime change in Iran. Mike Rogers has only cheered Trump's extreme policies, and, if elected, he'd rubber-stamp them without a second thought. Folks can't afford their groceries. Gas is too expensive. Young people worry they'll never be able to hold a job or own a home, and healthcare access continues to be stripped away. This November, we can do something about that. We can get money out of politics. We can put money in your pocket. And we can deliver Medicare for All. This election is a referendum on politics as usual. We have a choice between a government that serves Michigan or a government that serves Donald Trump and the corporations from which he's enriching himself. Michiganders, the choice is yours. Our children are counting on us. Peter, that's the column. Here's the part I didn't have room to say in the paper. I can't keep that promise to Emmalee and Serene, or to that kid in Grand Rapids, all on my own. Mike Rogers is banking on his corporate backers to carry him into the Senate. I'm counting on you. So please, contribute $10 or any amount today so that we can keep putting Mike Rogers's record in front of Michigan voters — on the air, at the doors, and at every town hall he won't show up to — through Election Day. [ ] Thank you so much, Abdul

Team Baumgartner,
Thank you! I can report from the field that Republicans are returning their ballots. I’ve heard it directly when I’m out doorbelling and also from supporters who have texted their updates to the campaign. Your support is paying off.
Republican ballots are returning at a strong pace, and we are on track to win. But only if we finish this the way we started it: together, and all the way through Election Day.

name: Abdul El-Sayed
subject: Let them have the drama
body:
| | | |
---
There's a lot of noise out there right now. We can’t be distracted. Some people would love for the last days of this race to be about politicians. Who said what. Who's mad at whom. Screenshots and hot takes. I will not be distracted. Every minute spent talking about politicians is a minute taken from the people this election is really about: working Michiganders. — This election is about the dad I met who told me his kid is really good at baseball but can't play next year because he just can't afford it.— This election is about everyone who's been told to wait for relief to “trickle down” while groceries, rent, and healthcare slip further out of reach. — And it's about people far beyond our state. Because Michigan will decide control of the United States Senate. A Democratic Senate is how we put a check on Donald Trump's power. Last weekend, our editor Matt Miller was not the only PolitiBrawl journalist **[to report on the ground in Paris.](https://substack.com/redirect/4ca16c08-11f0-47c0-9908-76be91d5f16e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
I was also given the opportunity to travel to France and see the chaos for myself. This assignment also meant it was my first time in Europe. As someone who has covered riots in the United States and Mexico, I have long wanted to add France to my belt since the French go all out with their unrest.
Despite the rain, I did not have to wait long for the crowd to start attacking French police.
## [Watch my footage from the riots:](https://substack.com/redirect/65ac59a7-44b9-4c98-8ee4-b63c04eb8ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/65ac59a7-44b9-4c98-8ee4-b63c04eb8ce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
What made last weekend's riot interesting was the French government's attempt to limit the damage that was sure to come. They tried this tactic by forcing the planned march to take place far away from the rich areas in Paris' center and have it instead take place on the southeast side.
This plan actually worked in terms of limiting looting and random arson on buildings. I only saw one attempted break-in despite many stores not being boarded up.
Instead of stores, rioters focused on the police. A few fires were set but they stayed small due to the rain. The crowd attempted to form barricades in the road, but they were quickly rushed by officers to prevent the barricades from becoming solidified.
The French are no strangers to riots and revolution. What makes these recent bouts of violence different is the composition of many rioters, namely second and third-generation migrants. The question becomes, should the more radical elements succeed, what will France look like at the end of it?
The rioters are not only composed of the immigrants, but also French who are communists and anarchists. It is a perfect alliance that seeks to tear down and replace what it means to be French, at least in its current form.

In two days Granite Staters will head to the polls to choose our next U.S. Senator.
**And unlike other states, over 90% of New Hampshire voters will cast their ballots on November 3rd.**
That means that what we do right here, right now has an outsized impact not only on New Hampshire's future _but on our country 's future, because the path to flipping the Senate runs through the Granite State._
That's why we're launching our Last Chance Fund today -- and setting**a goal of raising $300,000 between now and November 3rd.**
Every dollar we raise will help get out our message and power voters to the polls until the very end.
**[Will you pitch in $15 to the Last Chance Fund right now to help Granite Staters get to the polls and cast their ballots?](https://substack.com/redirect/cc3a1dc7-816d-4c02-80f5-4d8b299adfc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ CHIP IN TO OUR LAST CHANCE FUND >>](https://substack.com/redirect/cc3a1dc7-816d-4c02-80f5-4d8b299adfc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The next two days are a make-or-break moment in this race. We need to get every eligible NH voter we can out to the polls so we keep New Hampshire blue and flip the Senate.
This Last Chance Fund isn't a nice-to-have -- it's a must-have. It could be the difference between victory and defeat when we wake up on November 4th.
**[Please, make a donation of $15 or whatever you can today to help us hit our $300,000 goal before it's too late.](https://substack.com/redirect/cc3a1dc7-816d-4c02-80f5-4d8b299adfc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/cc3a1dc7-816d-4c02-80f5-4d8b299adfc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you,
Chris Pappas
**We have less than 48 hours left in this campaign.**
John Sununu has taken the lead in the polls thanks to over $67 million in GOP spending -- and they're taking over the New Hampshire airwaves.
We're running out of time to close this critical gap and keep New Hampshire blue.

While Rep. Thomas Massie and I disagree on many things, we can certainly agree on one: the rampant, pervasive corruption in Washington must come to an end.
His commitment to investigating corruption within his own party highlights the difference between him and my opponent, Andy Barr.
While Massie pushes for transparency, Barr has opposed releasing the Epstein files, embraced special-interest influence in our elections, and continued backing President Trump even when courts have ruled against his agenda.
Fighting corruption shouldn't be partisan; I'll work with anyone who puts Kentucky first. Unfortunately, Andy Barr has shown his priorities lie with the powerful - not the people he represents.
This race is tied, and with Election Day just six days away, I need your help to get this message to Kentucky voters.
**Will you chip in $5, $10, or whatever you can today to help me finish this fight strong and bring accountable, Kentucky-first leadership to the Senate?**
[ Chip in to my Senate Campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/ef4eb0a1-0871-4983-a8d4-047836cfff43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you.
_**Charles**_

Hey — this is the most important number in my head right now: **2,629**. That’s how many votes I flipped this seat by in 2022. That's **_less than four votes per precinct_**. That’s actually nuts! I mean, picture going to vote on Election Day, and imagine just four fewer people show up at your polling place — that could be the difference not just in this race, but in the entire fight for control of the House. Assuming the race this year is just as close as it was in ‘22 — and the latest poll has me tied with Braun, so that’s a safe assumption — we have to make sure every single undecided voter hears directly from me about the stakes of this race and why I am the right person to fight for them and their family in Congress. Seems like a straightforward task, but when you throw in the $6 million Donald Trump has dumped into the district and the millions Mike Johnson’s PAC is spending, too, it gets a lot harder. The truth is, we’re being drowned out. Unless we pick up our fundraising—like, today— we won’t be able to reach those undecided voters. **Patriot, it’s John James. **
We're just **3 days** away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. _I promise I will not waste your time._
I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted.
I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, _**I would live it.**_

Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army.
During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. **Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. **
**I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and _I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud._**

I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, I would live it. Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army. During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud. After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician... I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents. Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024. Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate. My dedication to this country, my loyalty towards my constituents, and my desire to see the greatest nation on earth excel are part of the reasons why I’m now emailing you, but they’re not my #1 reason why... These three kids are the reason why I’m sending this message to you, as a TRUMP-ENDORSED Republican and father running to be the next Governor of Michigan. Having my own family taught me more lessons than I could list, and it was the one thing being in the U.S. Army didn’t prepare me for. But it also awoke in me a desire to do EVERYTHING and ANYTHING I can to ensure my kids have bright futures. # [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=1231%2E127862%2E_M-DGD)
Here are the margins from the latest Emerson poll:
[](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20261101_3_ak.TzoLdD&refcode=em20261101-1231&%3Bamount=5&t=3&akid=1231%2E127862%2E_M-DGD)
We're leading by 2 points. I'm proud of that, but that’s not the number I want this team to focus on.
**I want you focused on that 11%: the Nevada voters who still haven't made up their minds.**

Hi, it's Troy Jackson. I'm sharing a note from my friend, Abdul El-Sayed, because the stakes couldn't be higher in our races. Will you read it then **[split $15 between our campaigns?](https://substack.com/redirect/418286d6-5f94-49ca-bfe7-68dae79c068a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* * *
Hey, there's a lot of noise out there right now. We can't be distracted.
Some people would love for the last days of this race to be about politicians. Who said what. Who's mad at whom. Screenshots and hot takes.
**I will not be distracted.** Every minute spent talking about politicians is a minute taken from the people this election is really about: working Michiganders.
-- This election is**** about the dad I met who told me his kid is really good at baseball but can't play next year because he just can't afford it.
-- This election is about everyone who's been told to wait for relief to "trickle down" while groceries, rent, and healthcare slip further out of reach.
-- And it's about people far beyond our state. Because Michigan will decide control of the United States Senate. A Democratic Senate is how we put a check on Donald Trump's power. Mike Rogers, Trump's handpicked candidate, wants to be one more vote for the same billionaire agenda that's been fleecing Michigan for decades.
Please don't get distracted by the political drama. I promise you I won't.
Election Day is Tuesday. Several polls show us statistically tied with Mike Rogers. In 2024, the Senate race here came down to 20,217 votes.
**I 'm told there's still time to put our final get-out-the-vote ads in front of Michigan voters, but only if we have the cash to run them right now.**
**[Please split a donation of $15 or any amount right now to fund Troy Jackson and our last get-out-the-vote ads before polls close on Tuesday.](https://substack.com/redirect/418286d6-5f94-49ca-bfe7-68dae79c068a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Let them have the drama. Let us earn the votes.
Abdul

body:

Peter, I’m in a bit of a bind.
With less than 48 hours until Election Day, we need to raise another $1 million to reach and turn out millions of voters across North Carolina. [**_I'm hoping there's something I can say to convince you to chip in your first $5 donation to my campaign right away._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1762&amount=5&t=8&akid=5178%2E124072%2E79ftM5)
Would you give $5 if you knew that President Trump recently returned to NC to lie about me and rally the MAGA base behind his hand-picked candidate, Michael Whatley?

clean_body: Dem said it on camera at the University of Chicago. | When I was a young man, I served my country in the U.S. Army. Later I became an FBI special agent. Nobody told me public service was something to be afraid of. Fellow Patriot, that is why what a Democrat Senator from Michigan said last week stopped me cold. Speaking at the University of Chicago on October 13, the Democrat Senator admitted that she wants to go after not just President Trump, but “the people who enabled him.” Then she said she wants young people coming out of school to think twice before they go work for the Trump administration. In her own words: “I want that deterrence message.” if you work for or support President Trump we will come for you. They have already tried to impeach the President multiple times, tried to jail him and his family, they’ve gone after Elon and had lists of every Trump supporter. My opponent, El-Sayed, supports all of this. He will be a SURE vote for Schumer to weaponize the government against political opponents. I have spent my career encouraging young Americans to serve. Democrats want the youth to be scared to be conservative. Now ask yourself what happens if my opponent, Abdul El-Sayed, wins this race. Do you think he would stand up to these unhinged Democrats? Or would he stand right next to them? If El-Sayed wins, Democrats will get their wish and have free range to target and go after President Trump and anyone who supports him, including folks like us. I am running so Michigan has a Senator who will encourage young people to serve our great nation regardless of political affiliation, not deter them away. But with 12 days left, I cannot do it alone. ## 18 Paid Subscribers Short. 2 Days To Fix It--And Win This Election!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6e3c46ee-1f51-4192-adf0-daf18eba21a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Friends,
2 days! 48 hours! We're soooo close...
You've been here for us, the same way we want to continue to be here for you, and _for those who 've kept_ _filling your screen with columns, inside info, liberal attitude, humor, Lives!_ _Thru research, writing, reporting, booking guests, producing shows._
_Those who keep on going when the news makes us all want to toss our phones in the lake_.
**[We're just 18 paid subscribers short of our goal. Will you be one of them?](https://substack.com/redirect/6e3c46ee-1f51-4192-adf0-daf18eba21a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Our **30% off sale ends at midnight on Election Day, Tuesday, November 3.** Those next 18 subscriptions will help us put our next round of offerings into motion--and keep paying the hardworking staff who make Blue Amp Media (BAM) possible.
* * *
### You're our owners. You're our engine.
**We 're reaching out to you because you're our most active readers, commenters, like-ers. You--our top supporters--took this little Substack we began in January, 2025, **_**and turned it into one of the 10 biggest political Substacks**_**.** _**Allowing us to elect better leaders, stop bad legislation, share oppo research that ended careers of MAGA fiends.**_
**You helped us change the narrative about Democrats vs Republicans** _**that has directly led to the coming Blue Tsunami.**_
**You Made This Happen.**
But this work takes people. Those people deserve paychecks. _And without our staff, we couldn 't have given you any of this_.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6e3c46ee-1f51-4192-adf0-daf18eba21a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Blue Amp Media is owned entirely by our paid subscriber community.** No billionaires. No corporate parent picking up the tab. You give us the freedom to say what needs saying, then needs saying again--and the resources to keep showing up.
We can't wait to unveil what we're planning for after the election: new offerings, more conversations, and more ways to bring you inside our work. But turning those plans into something you can actually watch, read, and enjoy [requires paid support now](https://substack.com/redirect/6e3c46ee-1f51-4192-adf0-daf18eba21a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* * *
### Tuesday: 12 hours. One extraordinary community.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6e3c46ee-1f51-4192-adf0-daf18eba21a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This Tuesday, **David Shuster and I are hosting our 12-hour Election Day livestream, from 7am to 7pm --Note: we may slightly push the start back to 8am, but it's still an 11-hr, 12-hr marathon! If you see my point--at [blueamp.co](https://substack.com/redirect/36cf2a3c-8e80-4566-a29f-c3405ef65ae0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
**With a guest lineup that includes** **Mark Hamill, Chris Meloni, Joyce Vance, Jim Acosta** , **Katie Phang, Steve Schmidt, Julie Roginsky, Miles Taylor, Shannon Watts, Joe Trippi, Malcolm Nance, Joe Walsh, former Senator Jon Tester --and more!**
12-ish hours of company, commentary, humor, and determination as we get thru this election together. The kinda gathering only th BAM community could make possible.
#### [And we're bringing paid subscribers behind the scenes](https://substack.com/redirect/6e3c46ee-1f51-4192-adf0-daf18eba21a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**Subscribe during our 30% off sale, and you 'll join our other paid subscribers in receiving an exclusive video of private behind-the-scenes, bloopers, clips:** _Mark Hamill, Chris Meloni, Joyce Vance, Jim Acosta, and our crew chatting, setting up, and being ourselves between the on-air moments._
The conversations before the conversation. **The stuff you don 't see on the broadcast.** A little backstage chaos, delivered to you.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6e3c46ee-1f51-4192-adf0-daf18eba21a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
### Help us close that final gap
If you've been waiting for the moment to become a paid subscriber, **this is it: 30% off, the exclusive backstage video, and a direct role in making Blue amp Media 's next chapter happen.**
**[We need 18 more paid subscribers to reach this goal. Please be one of them](https://substack.com/redirect/6e3c46ee-1f51-4192-adf0-daf18eba21a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**
**[[Become a paid subscriber--get 30% off through midnight Election Day](https://substack.com/redirect/6e3c46ee-1f51-4192-adf0-daf18eba21a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)]**
And to everyone who has read, watched, shared, commented, brought a friend, or already subscribed: **thank you**. You've made this campaign a community effort. Every bit of your involvement matters.
You keep us going. We'll keep you informed--and give you plenty of reasons to keep showing up.
Cliff
PS See you Tuesday!

| | Peter, there’s a certain reality that comes with running for governor as a Black man in the South.

**[I want to share with you something that happened to me recently. But first, I have to ask: Will you chip in any amount you can to help me make history as South Carolina’s first Black governor? We're just 5 days away from the election and there's no time to waste.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142703561/657757557/-505212388?refcode=102926_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAwNzkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2ZiNjFkYWYtNGVkNi1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNTQ0NDJlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=gc3mLDQy-g0KOteQ-Y6FVAVpwHLdbOU3s2A7oZGO_Jo=)** Peter, here’s the latest racist message to hit my inbox:
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/142703562/657757558/-505212388?refcode=102926_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTAwNzkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2ZiNjFkYWYtNGVkNi1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNTQ0NDJlIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=gc3mLDQy-g0KOteQ-Y6FVAVpwHLdbOU3s2A7oZGO_Jo=)

Peter,
We’re down to the final two days of this campaign — and I’m still on the road, talking to as many Texans as possible. The energy at our rallies has been amazing, and I’m keeping that energy up by calling supporters in between stops to say _thank you._
**We’re in a dead heat with Greg Abbott — in the closest governor’s race in the country — all thanks to the support of this movement.** The polls are showing that we can win. That’s only possible because of this people-powered movement fighting for a Texas that benefits everyone, _not just the wealthy and powerful few._
That’s why we can’t slow down until we’ve reached as many voters as possible, right up until the very last ballot is cast. Abbott will be tapping into his billionaire war chest for last-ditch efforts. **But I have you — and this people power is much more powerful.**
Many doubted this campaign when we launched last year. Now, we’re on the edge of making history. **[Chip in anything you can right now to help this movement finish strong and take back Texas, and you might get a call from me to say thanks.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261101_4_road.MjvaD4&refcode=em20261101-2605&t=3&akid=2605%2E299639%2EtfZwSp)**

— Gina
